verses.en: Now in the first year of Cyrus king of Persia, that the word of the Lord by the mouth of Jeremiah might be fulfilled, the Lord stirred up the spirit of Cyrus king of Persia, that he made a proclamation throughout all his kingdom, and put it also in writing, saying,
verses.fr: La première année de Cyrus, roi de Perse, afin que s''accomplît la parole de l''Eternel prononcée par la bouche de Jérémie, l''Eternel réveilla l''esprit de Cyrus, roi de Perse, qui fit faire de vive voix et par écrit cette publication dans tout son royaume:
verses.am: በኤርምያስም አፍ የተናገረው የእግዚአብሔር ቃል ይፈጸም ዘንድ በፋርስ ንጉሥ በቂሮስ በመጀመሪያው ዓመት እግዚአብሔር የፋርስን ንጉሥ የቂሮስን መንፈስ አስነሣ፤ እርሱም በመንግሥቱ ሁሉ አዋጅ አስነገረ፥ ደግሞም በጽሕፈት አድርጎ እንዲህ አለ።

verses.en: Thus saith Cyrus king of Persia, The Lord God of heaven hath given me all the kingdoms of the earth; and he hath charged me to build him an house at Jerusalem, which is in Judah.
verses.fr: Ainsi parle Cyrus, roi des Perses: L''Eternel, le Dieu des cieux, m''a donné tous les royaumes de la terre, et il m''a commandé de lui bâtir une maison à Jérusalem en Juda.
verses.am: የፋርስ ንጉሥ ቂሮስ እንዲህ ይላል። የሰማይ አምላክ እግዚአብሔር የምድርን መንግሥታት ሁሉ ሰጥቶኛል፤ በይሁዳም ባለችው በኢየሩሳሌም ቤት እሠራለት ዘንድ አዝዞኛል፤

verses.en: Who is there among you of all his people? his God be with him, and let him go up to Jerusalem, which is in Judah, and build the house of the Lord God of Israel, (he is the God,) which is in Jerusalem.
verses.fr: Qui d''entre vous est de son peuple? Que son Dieu soit avec lui, et qu''il monte à Jérusalem en Juda et bâtisse la maison de l''Eternel, le Dieu d''Israël! C''est le Dieu qui est à Jérusalem.
verses.am: ከሕዝቡ ሁሉ በእንናተ ዘንድ ማንም ቢሆን አምላኩ ከእርሱ ጋር ይሁን፥ እርሱም በይሁዳ ወዳለችው ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም ይውጣ፥ በኢየሩሳሌምም ለሚኖረው አምላክ፥ ለእስራኤል አምላክ ለእግዚአብሔር ቤት ይሥራ፤

verses.en: And whosoever remaineth in any place where he sojourneth, let the men of his place help him with silver, and with gold, and with goods, and with beasts, beside the freewill offering for the house of God that is in Jerusalem.
verses.fr: Dans tout lieu où séjournent des restes du peuple de l''Eternel, les gens du lieu leur donneront de l''argent, de l''or, des effets, et du bétail, avec des offrandes volontaires pour la maison de Dieu qui est à Jérusalem.
verses.am: በሚኖርበትም ስፍራ ሁሉ ለቀረው ሰው የአገሩ ሰዎች በብርና በወርቅ በዕቃም በእንስሳም ይርዱት፤ ይህም በኢየሩሳሌም ላለው ለእግዚአብሔር ቤት በፈቃዳቸው ከሚያቀርቡት ሌላ ይሁን።

verses.en: Then rose up the chief of the fathers of Judah and Benjamin, and the priests, and the Levites, with all them whose spirit God had raised, to go up to build the house of the Lord which is in Jerusalem.
verses.fr: Les chefs de famille de Juda et de Benjamin, les sacrificateurs et les Lévites, tous ceux dont Dieu réveilla l''esprit, se levèrent pour aller bâtir la maison de l''Eternel à Jérusalem.
verses.am: የይሁዳና የብንያም የአባቶች ቤቶች አለቆችም፥ ካህናቱም፥ ሌዋውያኑም፥ በኢየሩሳሌም ያለውን የእግዚአብሔርን ቤት ለመሥራት ይወጡ ዘንድ እግዚአብሔር መንፈሳቸውን ያነሣሣው ሁሉ ተነሡ።

verses.en: And all they that were about them strengthened their hands with vessels of silver, with gold, with goods, and with beasts, and with precious things, beside all that was willingly offered.
verses.fr: Tous leurs alentours leur donnèrent des objets d''argent, de l''or, des effets, du bétail, et des choses précieuses, outre toutes les offrandes volontaires.
verses.am: በዙሪያቸውም ያሉ ሁሉ በፈቃዳቸው ካቀረቡት ሁሉ ሌላ በብር ዕቃና በወርቅ በገንዘቦችና በእንስሶች በሌላም ስጦታ አገዙአቸው።

verses.en: Also Cyrus the king brought forth the vessels of the house of the Lord, which Nebuchadnezzar had brought forth out of Jerusalem, and had put them in the house of his gods;
verses.fr: Le roi Cyrus rendit les ustensiles de la maison de l''Eternel, que Nebucadnetsar avait emportés de Jérusalem et placés dans la maison de son dieu.
verses.am: ንጉሡ ቂሮስም ናቡከደነፆር ከኢየሩሳሌም ወስዶ በአማልክቱ ቤት ያኖራቸውን የእግዚአብሔርን ቤት ዕቃዎች አወጣ።

verses.en: Even those did Cyrus king of Persia bring forth by the hand of Mithredath the treasurer, and numbered them unto Sheshbazzar, the prince of Judah.
verses.fr: Cyrus, roi de Perse, les fit sortir par Mithredath, le trésorier, qui les remit à Scheschbatsar, prince de Juda.
verses.am: የፋርስ ንጉሥ ቂሮስም በመዝገቡ ላይ በነበረው በሚትሪዳጡ እጅ አወጣቸው፥ ለይሁዳም መስፍን ለሰሳብሳር ቈጠራቸው።

verses.en: And this is the number of them: thirty chargers of gold, a thousand chargers of silver, nine and twenty knives,
verses.fr: En voici le nombre: trente bassins d''or, mille bassins d''argent, vingt-neuf couteaux,
verses.am: ቍጥራቸውም ይህ ነው፤ ሠላሳ የወርቅ አንድ ሺህም የብር ሰሐኖች፥ ሀያ ዘጠኝም ቢላዎች፥

verses.en: Thirty basons of gold, silver basons of a second sort four hundred and ten, and other vessels a thousand.
verses.fr: trente coupes d''or, quatre cent dix coupes d''argent de second ordre, mille autres ustensiles.
verses.am: ሠላሳ የወርቅ ደካዎች፥ አራት መቶ አሥርም ሌላ ዓይነት የብር ደካዎች፥ አንድ ሺህም ሌላ ዕቃ ነበረ።

verses.en: All the vessels of gold and of silver were five thousand and four hundred. All these did Sheshbazzar bring up with them of the captivity that were brought up from Babylon unto Jerusalem.
verses.fr: Tous les objets d''or et d''argent étaient au nombre de cinq mille quatre cents. Scheschbatsar emporta le tout de Babylone à Jérusalem, au retour de la captivité.
verses.am: የወርቁና የብሩ ዕቃዎች ሁሉ አምስት ሺህ አራት መቶ ነበሩ፤ እነዚህንም ሁሉ ሰሳብሳር ከባቢሎን ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም ከተመለሱ ምርኮኞቹ ጋር ወሰደ።

verses.en: Now these are the children of the province that went up out of the captivity, of those which had been carried away, whom Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon had carried away unto Babylon, and came again unto Jerusalem and Judah, every one unto his city;
verses.fr: Voici ceux de la province qui revinrent de l''exil, ceux que Nebucadnetsar, roi de Babylone, avait emmenés captifs à Babylone, et qui retournèrent à Jérusalem et en Juda, chacun dans sa ville.
verses.am: የባቢሎንም ንጉሥ ናቡከደነፆር ወደ ባቢሎን ከማረካቸው ምርኮኞች ወደ ኢየሩሳሌምና ወደ ይሁዳ ወደ እየከተማቸው የተመለሱት የአገር ልጆች እነዚህ ናቸው።

verses.en: Which came with Zerubbabel: Jeshua, Nehemiah, Seraiah, Reelaiah, Mordecai, Bilshan, Mizpar, Bigvai, Rehum, Baanah. The number of the men of the people of Israel:
verses.fr: Ils partirent avec Zorobabel, Josué, Néhémie, Seraja, Reélaja, Mardochée, Bilschan, Mispar, Bigvaï, Rehum, Baana. Nombre des hommes du peuple d''Israël:
verses.am: ከዘሩባቤል፥ ከኢያሱ፥ ከነህምያ፥ ከሠራያ፥ ከረዕላያ፥ ከመርዶክዮስ፥ ከበላሳን፥ ከመሴፋር፥ ከበጉዋይ፥ ከሬሁም፥ ከበዓና ጋር መጡ።

verses.en: The children of Parosh, two thousand an hundred seventy and two.
verses.fr: les fils de Pareosch, deux mille cent soixante-douze;
verses.am: የእስራኤልም ሕዝብ ሰዎች ቍጥር ይህ ነው፤ የፋሮስ ልጆች፥ ሁለት ሺህ መቶ ሰባ ሁለት።

verses.en: The children of Shephatiah, three hundred seventy and two.
verses.fr: les fils de Schephathia, trois cent soixante-douze;
verses.am: የሰፋጥያስ ልጆች፥ ሦስት መቶ ሰባ ሁለት።

verses.en: The children of Arah, seven hundred seventy and five.
verses.fr: les fils d''Arach, sept cent soixante-quinze;
verses.am: የኤራ ልጆች፥ ሰባት መቶ ሰባ አምስት።

verses.en: The children of Pahathmoab, of the children of Jeshua and Joab, two thousand eight hundred and twelve.
verses.fr: les fils de Pachath-Moab, des fils de Josué et de Joab, deux mille huit cent douze;
verses.am: ከኢያሱና ከኢዮአብ ልጆች የሆኑ የፈሐት ሞዓብ ልጆች፥ ሁለት ሺህ ስምንት መቶ አሥራ ሁለት።

verses.en: The children of Elam, a thousand two hundred fifty and four.
verses.fr: les fils d''Elam, mille deux cent cinquante-quatre;
verses.am: የኤላም ልጆች፥ ሺህ ሁለት መቶ አምሳ አራት።

verses.en: The children of Zattu, nine hundred forty and five.
verses.fr: les fils de Zatthu, neuf cent quarante-cinq;
verses.am: የዛቱዕ ልጆች፥ ዘጠኝ መቶ አርባ አምስት።

verses.en: The children of Zaccai, seven hundred and threescore.
verses.fr: les fils de Zaccaï, sept cent soixante;
verses.am: የዘካይ ልጆች ሰባት መቶ ስድሳ።

verses.en: The children of Bani, six hundred forty and two.
verses.fr: les fils de Bani, six cent quarante-deux;
verses.am: የባኒ ልጆች፥ ስድስት መቶ አርባ ሁለት።

verses.en: The children of Bebai, six hundred twenty and three.
verses.fr: les fils de Bébaï, six cent vingt-trois;
verses.am: የቤባይ ልጆች፥ ስድስት መቶ ሀያ ሦስት።

verses.en: The children of Azgad, a thousand two hundred twenty and two.
verses.fr: les fils d''Azgad, mille deux cent vingt-deux;
verses.am: የዓዝጋድ ልጆች፥ ሺህ ሁለት መቶ ሀያ ሁለት።

verses.en: The children of Adonikam, six hundred sixty and six.
verses.fr: les fils d''Adonikam, six cent soixante-six;
verses.am: የአዶኒቃም ልጆች፥ ስድስት መቶ ስድሳ ስድስት።

verses.en: The children of Bigvai, two thousand fifty and six.
verses.fr: les fils de Bigvaï, deux mille cinquante-six;
verses.am: የበጉዋይ ልጆች፥ ሁለት ሺህ አምሳ ስድስት።

verses.en: The children of Adin, four hundred fifty and four.
verses.fr: les fils d''Adin, quatre cent cinquante-quatre;
verses.am: የዓዲን ልጆች፥ አራት መቶ አምሳ አራት።

verses.en: The children of Ater of Hezekiah, ninety and eight.
verses.fr: les fils d''Ather, de la famille d''Ezéchias, quatre-vingt-dix-huit;
verses.am: ከሕዝቅያስ ወገን የአጤር ልጆች፥ ዘጠና ስምንት።

verses.en: The children of Bezai, three hundred twenty and three.
verses.fr: les fils de Betsaï, trois cent vingt-trois;
verses.am: የቤሳይ ልጆች፥ ሦስት መቶ ሀያ ሦስት።

verses.en: The children of Jorah, an hundred and twelve.
verses.fr: les fils de Jora, cent douze;
verses.am: የዮራ ልጆች፥ መቶ አሥራ ሁለት።

verses.en: The children of Hashum, two hundred twenty and three.
verses.fr: les fils de Haschum, deux cent vingt-trois;
verses.am: የሐሱም ልጆች፥ ሁለት መቶ ሀያ ሦስት።

verses.en: The children of Gibbar, ninety and five.
verses.fr: les fils de Guibbar, quatre-vingt-quinze;
verses.am: የነጦፋ ሰዎች፥ አምሳ ስድስት።

verses.en: The children of Bethlehem, an hundred twenty and three.
verses.fr: les fils de Bethléhem, cent vingt-trois;
verses.am: የነጦፋ ሰዎች፥ አምሳ ስድስት።

verses.en: The men of Netophah, fifty and six.
verses.fr: les gens de Nethopha, cinquante-six;
verses.am: የዓናቶት ሰዎች፥ መቶ ሀያ ስምንት።

verses.en: The men of Anathoth, an hundred twenty and eight.
verses.fr: les gens d''Anathoth, cent vingt-huit;
verses.am: የዓዝሞት ልጆች፥ አርባ ሁለት።

verses.en: The children of Azmaveth, forty and two.
verses.fr: les fils d''Azmaveth, quarante-deux;
verses.am: የቂርያትይዓሪምና የከፊራ የብኤሮትም ልጆች፥ ሰባት መቶ አርባ ሦስት።

verses.en: The children of Kirjatharim, Chephirah, and Beeroth, seven hundred and forty and three.
verses.fr: les fils de Kirjath-Arim, de Kephira et de Beéroth, sept cent quarante trois;
verses.am: የራማና የጌባ ልጆች፥ ስድስት መቶ ሀያ አንድ።

verses.en: The children of Ramah and Gaba, six hundred twenty and one.
verses.fr: les fils de Rama et de Guéba, six cent vingt et un;
verses.am: የማክማስ ሰዎች፥ መቶ ሀያ ሁለት።

verses.en: The men of Michmas, an hundred twenty and two.
verses.fr: les gens de Micmas, cent vingt-deux;
verses.am: የቤቴልና የጋይ ሰዎች፥ ሁለት መቶ ሀያ ሦስት።

verses.en: The men of Bethel and Ai, two hundred twenty and three.
verses.fr: les gens de Béthel et d''Aï, deux cent vingt-trois;
verses.am: የናባው ልጆች፥ አምሳ ሁለት።

verses.en: The children of Nebo, fifty and two.
verses.fr: les fils de Nebo, cinquante-deux;
verses.am: የመጌብስ ልጆች፥ መቶ አምሳ ስድስት።

verses.en: The children of Magbish, an hundred fifty and six.
verses.fr: les fils de Magbisch, cent cinquante-six;
verses.am: የሁለተኛውም ኤላም ልጆች፥ ሺህ ሁለት መቶ አምሳ አራት።

verses.en: The children of the other Elam, a thousand two hundred fifty and four.
verses.fr: les fils de l''autre Elam, mille deux cent cinquante-quatre;
verses.am: የካሪም ልጆች፥ ሦስት መቶ ሀያ።

verses.en: The children of Harim, three hundred and twenty.
verses.fr: les fils de Harim, trois cent vingt;
verses.am: የሎድና የሐዲድ የኦኖም ልጆች፥ ሰባት መቶ ሀያ አምስት።

verses.en: The children of Lod, Hadid, and Ono, seven hundred twenty and five.
verses.fr: les fils de Lod, de Hadid et d''Ono, sept cent vingt-cinq;
verses.am: የኢያሪኮ ልጆች፥ ሦስት መቶ አርባ አምስት።

verses.en: The children of Jericho, three hundred forty and five.
verses.fr: les fils de Jéricho, trois cent quarante-cinq;
verses.am: የሴናዓ ልጆች፥ ሦስት ሺህ ስድስት መቶ ሠላሳ።

verses.en: The children of Senaah, three thousand and six hundred and thirty.
verses.fr: les fils de Senaa, trois mille six cent trente.
verses.am: ካህናቱ፤ ከኢያሱ ወገን የዮዳኤ ልጆች፥ ዘጠኝ መቶ ሰባ ሦስት።

verses.en: The priests: the children of Jedaiah, of the house of Jeshua, nine hundred seventy and three.
verses.fr: Sacrificateurs: les fils de Jedaeja, de la maison de Josué, neuf cent soixante-treize;
verses.am: የኢሜር ልጆች፥ ሺህ አምሳ ሁለት።

verses.en: The children of Immer, a thousand fifty and two.
verses.fr: les fils d''Immer, mille cinquante-deux;
verses.am: የፋስኮር ልጆች፥ ሺህ ሁለት መቶ አርባ ሰባት።

verses.en: The children of Pashur, a thousand two hundred forty and seven.
verses.fr: les fils de Paschhur, mille deux cent quarante-sept;
verses.am: የካሪም ልጆች፥ ሺህ አሥራ ሰባት።

verses.en: The children of Harim, a thousand and seventeen.
verses.fr: les fils de Harim, mille dix-sept.
verses.am: ሌዋውያኑ፤ ከሆዳይዋ ወገን የኢያሱና የቀድምኤል ልጆች፥ ሰባ አራት።

verses.en: The Levites: the children of Jeshua and Kadmiel, of the children of Hodaviah, seventy and four.
verses.fr: Lévites: les fils de Josué et de Kadmiel, des fils d''Hodavia, soixante quatorze.
verses.am: መዘምራኑ፤ የአሳፍ ልጆች፥ መቶ ሀያ ስምንት።

verses.en: The singers: the children of Asaph, an hundred twenty and eight.
verses.fr: Chantres: les fils d''Asaph, cent vingt-huit.
verses.am: የበረኞች ልጆች፤ የሰሎም ልጆች፥ የአጤር ልጆች፥ የጤልሞን ልጆች፥ የዓቁብ ልጆች፥ የሐጢጣ ልጆች፥ የሶባይ ልጆች፥ ሁሉ መቶ ሠላሳ ዘጠኝ።

verses.en: The children of the porters: the children of Shallum, the children of Ater, the children of Talmon, the children of Akkub, the children of Hatita, the children of Shobai, in all an hundred thirty and nine.
verses.fr: Fils des portiers: les fils de Schallum, les fils d''Ather, les fils de Thalmon, les fils d''Akkub, les fils de Hathitha, les fils de Schobaï, en tout cent trente-neuf.
verses.am: ናታኒም፤ የሲሐ ልጆች፥ የሐሡፋ ልጆች፥

verses.en: The Nethinims: the children of Ziha, the children of Hasupha, the children of Tabbaoth,
verses.fr: Néthiniens: les fils de Tsicha, les fils de Hasupha, les fils de Thabbaoth,
verses.am: የጠብዖት ልጆች፥ የኬራስ ልጆች፥ የሲዓ ልጆች፤

verses.en: The children of Keros, the children of Siaha, the children of Padon,
verses.fr: les fils de Kéros, les fils de Siaha, les fils de Padon,
verses.am: የፋዶን ልጆች፥ የልባና ልጆች፥

verses.en: The children of Lebanah, the children of Hagabah, the children of Akkub,
verses.fr: les fils de Lebana, les fils de Hagaba, les fils d''Akkub,
verses.am: የአጋባ ልጆች፥ የዓቁብ ልጆች፥ የአጋብ ልጆች፥ የሰምላይ ልጆች፥ የሐናን ልጆች፥

verses.en: The children of Hagab, the children of Shalmai, the children of Hanan,
verses.fr: les fils de Hagab, les fils de Schamlaï, les fils de Hanan,
verses.am: የጌዴል ልጆች፥ የጋሐር ልጆች፥ የራያ ልጆች፥

verses.en: The children of Giddel, the children of Gahar, the children of Reaiah,
verses.fr: les fils de Guiddel, les fils de Gachar, les fils de Reaja,
verses.am: የረአሶን ልጆች፥ የኔቆዳ ልጆች፥

verses.en: The children of Rezin, the children of Nekoda, the children of Gazzam,
verses.fr: les fils de Retsin, les fils de Nekoda, les fils de Gazzam,
verses.am: የጋሴም ልጆች፥ የዖዛ ልጆች፥ የፋሴሐ ልጆች፥

verses.en: The children of Uzza, the children of Paseah, the children of Besai,
verses.fr: les fils d''Uzza, les fils de Paséach, les fils de Bésaï,
verses.am: የቤሳይ ልጆች፥ የአስና ልጆች፥ የምዑናውያን ልጆች፥ የንፉሰሲም ልጆች፥

verses.en: The children of Asnah, the children of Mehunim, the children of Nephusim,
verses.fr: les fils d''Asna, les fils de Mehunim, les fils de Nephusim,
verses.am: የበቅቡቅ ልጆች፥ የሐቁፋ ልጆች፥ የሐርሑር ልጆች፥

verses.en: The children of Bakbuk, the children of Hakupha, the children of Harhur,
verses.fr: les fils de Bakbuk, les fils de Hakupha, les fils de Harhur,
verses.am: የበስሎት ልጆች፥ የምሒዳ ልጆች፥

verses.en: The children of Bazluth, the children of Mehida, the children of Harsha,
verses.fr: les fils de Batsluth, les fils de Mehida, les fils de Harscha,
verses.am: የሐርሳ ልጆች፥ የበርቆስ ልጆች፥

verses.en: The children of Barkos, the children of Sisera, the children of Thamah,
verses.fr: les fils de Barkos, les fils de Sisera, les fils de Thamach,
verses.am: የሲሣራ ልጆች፥ የቴማ ልጆች፥ የንስያ ልጆች፥ የሐጢፋ ልጆች።

verses.en: The children of Neziah, the children of Hatipha.
verses.fr: les fils de Netsiach, les fils de Hathipha.
verses.am: የሰሎሞንም ባሪያዎች ልጆች፤ የሶጣይ ልጆች፥ የሶፌሬት ልጆች፥ የፍሩዳ ልጆች፥

verses.en: The children of Solomon's servants: the children of Sotai, the children of Sophereth, the children of Peruda,
verses.fr: Fils des serviteurs de Salomon: les fils de Sothaï, les fils de Sophéreth, les fils de Peruda,
verses.am: የየዕላ ልጆች፥ የደርቆን ልጆች፥ የጌዴል ልጆች፥

verses.en: The children of Jaalah, the children of Darkon, the children of Giddel,
verses.fr: les fils de Jaala, les fils de Darkon, les fils de Guiddel,
verses.am: የሰፋጥያስ ልጆች፥ የሐጢል ልጆች፥ የፈክራት ልጆች፥ የሐፂቦይም ልጆች፥ የአሚ ልጆች።

verses.en: The children of Shephatiah, the children of Hattil, the children of Pochereth of Zebaim, the children of Ami.
verses.fr: les fils de Schephathia, les fils de Hatthil, les fils de Pokéreth-Hatsebaïm, les fils d''Ami.
verses.am: እነዚህ ናታኒም ሁሉና የሰሎሞን ባሪያዎች ልጆች ሦስት መቶ ዘጠና ሁለት ነበሩ።

verses.en: All the Nethinims, and the children of Solomon's servants, were three hundred ninety and two.
verses.fr: Total des Néthiniens et des fils des serviteurs de Salomon: trois cent quatre-vingt-douze.
verses.am: ከቴልሜላ፥ ከቴላሬሳ፥ ከክሩብ፥ ከአዳን፥ ከኢሜር የወጡ እነዚህ ነበሩ፤ ነገር ግን የአባቶቻቸውን ቤቶችና ዘራቸውን ወይም ከእስራኤል ወገን መሆናቸውን ያስታውቁ ዘንድ አልቻሉም፤

verses.en: And these were they which went up from Telmelah, Telharsa, Cherub, Addan, and Immer: but they could not shew their father's house, and their seed, whether they were of Israel:
verses.fr: Voici ceux qui partirent de Thel-Mélach, de Thel-Harscha, de Kerub-Addan, et qui ne purent pas faire connaître leur maison paternelle et leur race, pour prouver qu''ils étaient d''Israël.
verses.am: የዳላያ ልጆች፥ የጦብያ ልጆች፥ የኔቆዳ ልጆች፥ ስድስት መቶ አምሳ ሁለት ነበሩ።

verses.en: The children of Delaiah, the children of Tobiah, the children of Nekoda, six hundred fifty and two.
verses.fr: Les fils de Delaja, les fils de Tobija, les fils de Nekoda, six cent cinquante-deux.
verses.am: ከካህናቱም ልጆች፤ የኤብያ ልጆች፥ የአቆስ ልጆች፥ ከገለዓዳዊው ከቤርዜሊ ልጆች ሚስት ያገባ፥ በስሙም የተጠራ የቤርዜሊ ልጆች።

verses.en: And of the children of the priests: the children of Habaiah, the children of Koz, the children of Barzillai; which took a wife of the daughters of Barzillai the Gileadite, and was called after their name:
verses.fr: Et parmi les fils des sacrificateurs: les fils de Habaja, les fils d''Hakkots, les fils de Barzillaï, qui avait pris pour femme une des filles de Barzillaï, le Galaadite, et fut appelé de leur nom.
verses.am: እነዚህ በትውልድ መጽሐፍ ትውልዳቸውን ፈለጉ፤ ነገር ግን አልተገኘም፥ ከክህነትም ተከለከሉ።

verses.en: These sought their register among those that were reckoned by genealogy, but they were not found: therefore were they, as polluted, put from the priesthood.
verses.fr: Ils cherchèrent leurs titres généalogiques, mais ils ne les trouvèrent point. On les exclut du sacerdoce,
verses.am: ሐቴርሰታም። በኡሪምና በቱሚም የሚፈርድ ካህን እስኪነሣ ድረስ ከቅዱሰ ቅዱሳን አትበሉም አላቸው።

verses.en: And the Tirshatha said unto them, that they should not eat of the most holy things, till there stood up a priest with Urim and with Thummim.
verses.fr: et le gouverneur leur dit de ne pas manger des choses très saintes jusqu''à ce qu''un sacrificateur ait consulté l''urim et le thummim.
verses.am: ፈረሶቻቸውም ሰባት መቶ ሠላሳ ስድስት በቅሎቻቸውም ሁለት መቶ አርባ አምስት፥

verses.en: The whole congregation together was forty and two thousand three hundred and threescore,
verses.fr: L''assemblée tout entière était de quarante-deux mille trois cent soixante personnes,
verses.am: ፈረሶቻቸውም ሰባት መቶ ሠላሳ ስድስት በቅሎቻቸውም ሁለት መቶ አርባ አምስት፥

verses.en: Beside their servants and their maids, of whom there were seven thousand three hundred thirty and seven: and there were among them two hundred singing men and singing women.
verses.fr: sans compter leurs serviteurs et leurs servantes, au nombre de sept mille trois cent trente-sept. Parmi eux se trouvaient deux cents chantres et chanteuses.
verses.am: ግመሎቻቸውም አራት መቶ ሠላሳ አምስት፥ አህዮቻቸውም ስድስት ሺህ ሰባት መቶ ሀያ ነበሩ።

verses.en: Their horses were seven hundred thirty and six; their mules, two hundred forty and five;
verses.fr: Ils avaient sept cent trente-six chevaux, deux cent quarante-cinq mulets,
verses.am: በኢየሩሳሌምም ወዳለው ወደ እግዚአብሔር ቤት በመጡ ጊዜ ከአባቶች ቤቶች አለቆች አያሌዎች ለእግዚአብሔር ቤት በስፍራው ይሠራ ዘንድ በፈቃዳቸው ሰጡ።

verses.en: Their camels, four hundred thirty and five; their asses, six thousand seven hundred and twenty.
verses.fr: quatre cent trente-cinq chameaux, et six mille sept cent vingt ânes.
verses.am: ስድሳ አንድ ሺህም የወርቅ ዳሪክ፥ አምስት ሺህም ምናን ብር፥ አንድ መቶም የካህናት ልብስ እንደ ችሎታቸው ወደ ሥራው ቤተ መዛግብት አቀረቡ።

verses.en: And some of the chief of the fathers, when they came to the house of the Lord which is at Jerusalem, offered freely for the house of God to set it up in his place:
verses.fr: Plusieurs des chefs de famille, à leur arrivée vers la maison de l''Eternel à Jérusalem, firent des offrandes volontaires pour la maison de Dieu, afin qu''on la rétablît sur le lieu où elle avait été.
verses.am: ካህናቱና ሌዋውያኑም፥ ከሕዝቡም አያሌዎች፥ መዘምራኑና በረኞቹም፥ ናታኒምም በከተሞቻቸው፥ እስራኤልም ሁሉ በከተሞቻቸው ተቀመጡ።

verses.en: They gave after their ability unto the treasure of the work threescore and one thousand drams of gold, and five thousand pound of silver, and one hundred priests' garments.
verses.fr: Ils donnèrent au trésor de l''oeuvre, selon leurs moyens, soixante et un mille dariques d''or, cinq mille mines d''argent, et cent tuniques sacerdotales.
verses.am: ፤ ስድሳ አንድ ሺህም የወርቅ ዳሪክ፥ አምስት ሺህም ምናን ብር፥ አንድ መቶም የካህናት ልብስ እንደ ችሎታቸው ወደ ሥራው ቤተ መዛግብት አቀረቡ።

verses.en: So the priests, and the Levites, and some of the people, and the singers, and the porters, and the Nethinims, dwelt in their cities, and all Israel in their cities.
verses.fr: Les sacrificateurs et les Lévites, les gens du peuple, les chantres, les portiers et les Néthiniens s''établirent dans leurs villes. Tout Israël habita dans ses villes.
verses.am: ፤ ካህናቱና ሌዋውያኑም፥ ከሕዝቡም አያሌዎች፥ መዘምራኑና በረኞቹም፥ ናታኒምም በከተሞቻቸው፥ እስራኤልም ሁሉ በከተሞቻቸው ተቀመጡ።

verses.en: And when the seventh month was come, and the children of Israel were in the cities, the people gathered themselves together as one man to Jerusalem.
verses.fr: Le septième mois arriva, et les enfants d''Israël étaient dans leurs villes. Alors le peuple s''assembla comme un seul homme à Jérusalem.
verses.am: ሰባተኛውም ወር በደረሰ ጊዜ፥ የእስራኤልም ልጆች በከተሞቻቸው ሳሉ፥ ሕዝቡ እንደ አንድ ሰው ሆነው ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም ተሰበሰቡ።

verses.en: Then stood up Jeshua the son of Jozadak, and his brethren the priests, and Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, and his brethren, and builded the altar of the God of Israel, to offer burnt offerings thereon, as it is written in the law of Moses the man of God.
verses.fr: Josué, fils de Jotsadak, avec ses frères les sacrificateurs, et Zorobabel, fils de Schealthiel, avec ses frères, se levèrent et bâtirent l''autel du Dieu d''Israël, pour y offrir des holocaustes, selon ce qui est écrit dans la loi de Moïse, homme de Dieu.
verses.am: የኢዮሴዴቅም ልጅ ኢያሱ፥ ወንድሞቹም ካህናቱ፥ የሰላትያልም ልጅ ዘሩባቤል ወንድሞቹም ተነሥተው በእግዚአብሔር ሰው በሙሴ ሕግ እንደ ተጻፈ የሚቃጠለውን መሥዋዕት ያቀርቡበት ዘንድ የእስራኤልን አምላክ መሠዊያ ሠሩ።

verses.en: And they set the altar upon his bases; for fear was upon them because of the people of those countries: and they offered burnt offerings thereon unto the Lord, even burnt offerings morning and evening.
verses.fr: Ils rétablirent l''autel sur ses fondements, quoiqu''ils eussent à craindre les peuples du pays, et ils y offrirent des holocaustes à l''Eternel, les holocaustes du matin et du soir.
verses.am: በአገሩም ካሉት አሕዛብ ፈርተው ነበርና መሠዊያውን በስፍራው ላይ አስቀመጡት፥ በጥዋትና በማታም የሚቃጠለውን መሥዋዕት ለእግዚአብሔር አቀረቡበት።

verses.en: They kept also the feast of tabernacles, as it is written, and offered the daily burnt offerings by number, according to the custom, as the duty of every day required;
verses.fr: Ils célébrèrent la fête des tabernacles, comme il est écrit, et ils offrirent jour par jour des holocaustes, selon le nombre ordonné pour chaque jour.
verses.am: እንደ ተጻፈውም የዳስ በዓል አደረጉ፤ እንደ ሥርዓቱም ለየዕለቱ የተገባውን የየዕለቱን የሚቃጠል መሥዋዕት በቍጥር አቀረቡ።

verses.en: And afterward offered the continual burnt offering, both of the new moons, and of all the set feasts of the Lord that were consecrated, and of every one that willingly offered a freewill offering unto the Lord.
verses.fr: Après cela, ils offrirent l''holocauste perpétuel, les holocaustes des nouvelles lunes et de toutes les solennités consacrées à l''Eternel, et ceux de quiconque faisait des offrandes volontaires à l''Eternel.
verses.am: ከዚያም በኋላ ዘወትር የሚቃጠለውን መሥዋዕት፥ የመባቻውንም መሥዋዕት፥ የተቀደሱትንም የእግዚአብሔር በዓላት ሁሉ መሥዋዕት፥ ሰውም ሁሉ ለእግዚአብሔር በፈቃድ የሰጠውን ቍርባን አቀረቡ።

verses.en: From the first day of the seventh month began they to offer burnt offerings unto the Lord. But the foundation of the temple of the Lord was not yet laid.
verses.fr: Dès le premier jour du septième mois, ils commencèrent à offrir à l''Eternel des holocaustes. Cependant les fondements du temple de l''Eternel n''étaient pas encore posés.
verses.am: በሰባተኛው ወር በመጀመሪያው ቀን ለእግዚአብሔር የሚቃጠል መሥዋዕት ማቅረብ ጀመሩ፤ የእግዚአብሔር መቅደስ ገና አልተመሠረተም ነበር።

verses.en: They gave money also unto the masons, and to the carpenters; and meat, and drink, and oil, unto them of Zidon, and to them of Tyre, to bring cedar trees from Lebanon to the sea of Joppa, according to the grant that they had of Cyrus king of Persia.
verses.fr: On donna de l''argent aux tailleurs de pierres et aux charpentiers, et des vivres, des boissons et de l''huile aux Sidoniens et aux Tyriens, pour qu''ils amenassent par mer jusqu''à Japho des bois de cèdre du Liban, suivant l''autorisation qu''on avait eue de Cyrus, roi de Perse.
verses.am: ለጠራቢዎችና ለአናጢዎችም ገንዘብ ሰጡ፤ የፋርስም ንጉሥ ቂሮስ እንደ ፈቀደላቸው የዝግባ ዛፍ ከሊባኖስ በባሕር ወደ ኢዮጴ ያመጡ ዘንድ ለሲዶናና ለጢሮስ ሰዎች መብልና መጠጥ ዘይትም ሰጡ።

verses.en: Now in the second year of their coming unto the house of God at Jerusalem, in the second month, began Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, and Jeshua the son of Jozadak, and the remnant of their brethren the priests and the Levites, and all they that were come out of the captivity unto Jerusalem; and appointed the Levites, from twenty years old and upward, to set forward the work of the house of the Lord.
verses.fr: La seconde année depuis leur arrivée à la maison de Dieu à Jérusalem, au second mois, Zorobabel, fils de Schealthiel, Josué, fils de Jotsadak, avec le reste de leurs frères les sacrificateurs et les Lévites, et tous ceux qui étaient revenus de la captivité à Jérusalem, se mirent à l''oeuvre et chargèrent les Lévites de vingt ans et au-dessus de surveiller les travaux de la maison de l''Eternel.
verses.am: በኢየሩሳሌም ወዳለው ወደ እግዚአብሔር ቤት በመጡ በሁለተኛው ዓመት በሁለተኛው ወር የሰላትያል ልጅ ዘሩባቤል፥ የኢዩሴዴቅም ልጅ ኢያሱ፥ የቀሩትም ወንድሞቻቸው ካህናትና ሌዋውያን፥ ወደ ኢየሩሳሌምም የተመለሱት ምርኮኞች ሁሉ ጀመሩ፤ ሌዋውያንንም ከሀያ ዓመት ጀምሮ ከዚያም በላይ የእግዚአብሔርን ቤት ሥራ እንዲያሠሩት ሾሙአቸው።

verses.en: Then stood Jeshua with his sons and his brethren, Kadmiel and his sons, the sons of Judah, together, to set forward the workmen in the house of God: the sons of Henadad, with their sons and their brethren the Levites.
verses.fr: Et Josué, avec ses fils et ses frères, Kadmiel, avec ses fils, fils de Juda, les fils de Hénadad, avec leurs fils et leurs frères les Lévites, se préparèrent tous ensemble à surveiller ceux qui travaillaient à la maison de Dieu.
verses.am: ኢያሱም ልጆቹም ወንድሞቹም፥ የይሁዳም ልጆች ቀድምኤልና ልጆቹ፥ የኤንሐዳድም ልጆች፥ ልጆቻቸውና ወንድሞቻቸው ሌዋውያንም የእግዚአብሔርን ቤት የሚሠሩትን ያሠሩ ዘንድ በአንድነት ቆሙ።

verses.en: And when the builders laid the foundation of the temple of the Lord, they set the priests in their apparel with trumpets, and the Levites the sons of Asaph with cymbals, to praise the Lord, after the ordinance of David king of Israel.
verses.fr: Lorsque les ouvriers posèrent les fondements du temple de l''Eternel, on fit assister les sacrificateurs en costume, avec les trompettes, et les Lévites, fils d''Asaph, avec les cymbales, afin qu''ils célébrassent l''Eternel, d''après les ordonnances de David, roi d''Israël.
verses.am: አናጢዎቹም የእግዚአብሔርን መቅደስ በመሠረቱ ጊዜ ካህናቱ ልብሳቸውን ለብሰው መለከቱን ይዘው፥ የአሳፍም ልጆች ሌዋውያን ጸናጽል ይዘው እንደ እስራኤል ንጉሥ እንደ ዳዊት ሥርዓት እግዚአብሔርን ያመሰግኑ ዘንድ ቆሙ።

verses.en: And they sang together by course in praising and giving thanks unto the Lord; because he is good, for his mercy endureth for ever toward Israel. And all the people shouted with a great shout, when they praised the Lord, because the foundation of the house of the Lord was laid.
verses.fr: Ils chantaient, célébrant et louant l''Eternel par ces paroles: Car il est bon, car sa miséricorde pour Israël dure à toujours! Et tout le peuple poussait de grands cris de joie en célébrant l''Eternel, parce qu''on posait les fondements de la maison de l''Eternel.
verses.am: ደግሞ። ቸር ነውና፥ ለእስራኤልም ምሕረቱ ለዘላለም ነውና እያሉ እግዚአብሔርንም እያመሰገኑና እያከበሩ እርስ በእርሳቸው ያስተዛዝሉ ነበር፤ የእግዚአብሔርም ቤት ስለ ተመሠረተ ሕዝቡ ሁሉ እግዚአብሔርን እያመሰገኑ በታላቅ ድምፅ እልል አሉ።

verses.en: But many of the priests and Levites and chief of the fathers, who were ancient men, that had seen the first house, when the foundation of this house was laid before their eyes, wept with a loud voice; and many shouted aloud for joy:
verses.fr: Mais plusieurs des sacrificateurs et des Lévites, et des chefs de famille âgés, qui avaient vu la première maison, pleuraient à grand bruit pendant qu''on posait sous leurs yeux les fondements de cette maison. Beaucoup d''autres faisaient éclater leur joie par des cris,
verses.am: የፊተኛውን ቤት ያዩ ሽማግሌዎች የሆኑ ብዙ ካህናትና ሌዋውያን የአባቶችም ቤቶች አለቆች ግን ይህ መቅደስ በፊታቸው በተመሠረተ ጊዜ በታላቅ ድምፅ ያለቅሱ ነበር፤ ብዙ ሰዎችም በደስታ ይጮኹ ነበር፤

verses.en: So that the people could not discern the noise of the shout of joy from the noise of the weeping of the people: for the people shouted with a loud shout, and the noise was heard afar off.
verses.fr: en sorte qu''on ne pouvait distinguer le bruit des cris de joie d''avec le bruit des pleurs parmi le peuple, car le peuple poussait de grands cris dont le son s''entendait au loin.
verses.am: ደስ ብሎአቸው የሚጮኹትን ድምፅ ከሕዝቡ ልቅሶ ድምፅ መለየት የሚችል አልነበረም፤ ሕዝቡም በታላቅ ድምፅ ይጮኽ ነበር፥ ድምፁም ከሩቅ ይሰማ ነበር።

verses.en: Now when the adversaries of Judah and Benjamin heard that the children of the captivity builded the temple unto the Lord God of Israel;
verses.fr: Les ennemis de Juda et de Benjamin apprirent que les fils de la captivité bâtissaient un temple à l''Eternel, le Dieu d''Israël.
verses.am: የይሁዳና የብንያምም ጠላቶች ምርኮኞቹ ለእስራኤል አምላክ ለእግዚአብሔር መቅደስ እንደ ሠሩ ሰሙ።

verses.en: Then they came to Zerubbabel, and to the chief of the fathers, and said unto them, Let us build with you: for we seek your God, as ye do; and we do sacrifice unto him since the days of Esarhaddon king of Assur, which brought us up hither.
verses.fr: Ils vinrent auprès de Zorobabel et des chefs de familles, et leur dirent: Nous bâtirons avec vous; car, comme vous, nous invoquons votre Dieu, et nous lui offrons des sacrifices depuis le temps d''Esar-Haddon, roi d''Assyrie, qui nous a fait monter ici.
verses.am: ወደ ዘሩባቤልና ወደ አባቶች ቤቶች አለቆች ቀርበው። የአሦር ንጉሥ አስራዶን ወደዚህ ካመጣን ቀን ጀምሮ ለአምላካችሁ እንሠዋለንና፥ እንደ እናንተም እንፈልገዋለንና ከእናንተ ጋር እንሥራ አሉአቸው።

verses.en: But Zerubbabel, and Jeshua, and the rest of the chief of the fathers of Israel, said unto them, Ye have nothing to do with us to build an house unto our God; but we ourselves together will build unto the Lord God of Israel, as king Cyrus the king of Persia hath commanded us.
verses.fr: Mais Zorobabel, Josué, et les autres chefs des familles d''Israël, leur répondirent: Ce n''est pas à vous et à nous de bâtir la maison de notre Dieu; nous la bâtirons nous seuls à l''Eternel, le Dieu d''Israël, comme nous l''a ordonné le roi Cyrus, roi de Perse.
verses.am: ዘሩባቤልና ኢያሱም የቀሩትም የእስራኤል አባቶች ቤቶች አለቆች። የአምላካችንን ቤት መሥራት ለእኛና ለእናንተ አይደለም፤ እኛ ለብቻችን ግን የፋርስ ንጉሥ ቂሮስ እንዳዘዘን ለእስራኤል አምላክ ለእግዚአብሔር ቤት እንሠራለን አሉአቸው።

verses.en: Then the people of the land weakened the hands of the people of Judah, and troubled them in building,
verses.fr: Alors les gens du pays découragèrent le peuple de Juda; ils l''intimidèrent pour l''empêcher de bâtir,
verses.am: የምድሩም ሕዝብ የይሁዳን ሕዝብ እጅ ያደክሙ ነበር፥ እንዳይሠሩም አስፈራሩአቸው፥

verses.en: And hired counsellors against them, to frustrate their purpose, all the days of Cyrus king of Persia, even until the reign of Darius king of Persia.
verses.fr: et ils gagnèrent à prix d''argent des conseillers pour faire échouer son entreprise. Il en fut ainsi pendant toute la vie de Cyrus, roi de Perse, et jusqu''au règne de Darius, roi de Perse.
verses.am: ምክራቸውንም ያፈርሱ ዘንድ በፋርሱ ንጉሥ በቂሮስ ዘመን ሁሉ እስከ ፋርስ ንጉሥ እስከ ዳርዮስ መንግሥት ድረስ መካሪዎችን ገዙባቸው።

verses.en: And in the reign of Ahasuerus, in the beginning of his reign, wrote they unto him an accusation against the inhabitants of Judah and Jerusalem.
verses.fr: Sous le règne d''Assuérus, au commencement de son règne, ils écrivirent une accusation contre les habitants de Juda et de Jérusalem.
verses.am: በአርጤክስስም መንግሥት፥ በመንግሥቱም በመጀመሪያ ዘመን፥ በይሁዳና በኢየሩሳሌም በሚኖሩት ላይ የክስ ነገር ጻፉ።

verses.en: And in the days of Artaxerxes wrote Bishlam, Mithredath, Tabeel, and the rest of their companions, unto Artaxerxes king of Persia; and the writing of the letter was written in the Syrian tongue, and interpreted in the Syrian tongue.
verses.fr: Et du temps d''Artaxerxès, Bischlam, Mithredath, Thabeel, et le reste de leurs collègues, écrivirent à Artaxerxès, roi de Perse. La lettre fut transcrite en caractères araméens et traduite en araméen.
verses.am: በአርጤክስስ ዘመን ቢሽላም፥ ሚትሪዳጡ፥ ጣብኤል ተባባሪዎቹም ለፋርስ ንጉሥ ለአርጤክስስ ጻፉ፤ ደብዳቤውም በሶርያ ፊደልና በሶርያ ቋንቋ ተጽፎ ነበር።

verses.en: Rehum the chancellor and Shimshai the scribe wrote a letter against Jerusalem to Artaxerxes the king in this sort:
verses.fr: Rehum, gouverneur, et Schimschaï, secrétaire écrivirent au roi Artaxerxès la lettre suivante concernant Jérusalem:
verses.am: አዛዡ ሬሁም ጸሐፊውም ሲምሳይ በኢየሩሳሌም ላይ ለንጉሡ ለአርጤክስስ እንዲህ የሚል ደብዳቤ ጻፉ።

verses.en: Then wrote Rehum the chancellor, and Shimshai the scribe, and the rest of their companions; the Dinaites, the Apharsathchites, the Tarpelites, the Apharsites, the Archevites, the Babylonians, the Susanchites, the Dehavites, and the Elamites,
verses.fr: Rehum, gouverneur, Schimschaï, secrétaire, et le reste de leurs collègues, ceux de Din, d''Arpharsathac, de Tharpel, d''Apharas, d''Erec, de Babylone, de Suse, de Déha, d''Elam,
verses.am: አዛዡ ሬሁም ጸሐፊውም ሲምሳይ የቀሩትም ተባባሪዎቻቸው፥ ዲናውያን፥ አፈርሳትካውያን፥ ጠርፈላውያን፥ አፈርሳውያን፥ አርካውያን፥ ባቢሎናውያን፥ ሱስናካውያን፥ ዴሐውያን፥ ኤላማውያን፥

verses.en: And the rest of the nations whom the great and noble Asnapper brought over, and set in the cities of Samaria, and the rest that are on this side the river, and at such a time.
verses.fr: et les autres peuples que le grand et illustre Osnappar a transportés et établis dans la ville de Samarie et autres lieux de ce côté du fleuve, etc.
verses.am: ታላቁና ኃይለኛው አስናፈር ያፈለሳቸው በሰማርያና በወንዝ ማዶ ያኖራቸው የቀሩትም አሕዛብ ደብዳቤውን ጻፉ።

verses.en: This is the copy of the letter that they sent unto him, even unto Artaxerxes the king; Thy servants the men on this side the river, and at such a time.
verses.fr: C''est ici la copie de la lettre qu''ils envoyèrent au roi Artaxerxès: Tes serviteurs, les gens de ce côté du fleuve, etc.
verses.am: ለንጉሡ ለአርጤክስስ የላኩት የደብዳቤ ግልባጭ ይህ ነው። በወንዝ ማዶ ያሉት ሰዎች ባሪያዎችህ፤

verses.en: Be it known unto the king, that the Jews which came up from thee to us are come unto Jerusalem, building the rebellious and the bad city, and have set up the walls thereof, and joined the foundations.
verses.fr: Que le roi sache que les Juifs partis de chez toi et arrivés parmi nous à Jérusalem rebâtissent la ville rebelle et méchante, en relèvent les murs et en restaurent les fondements.
verses.am: አሁንም ከአንተ ዘንድ የወጡ አይሁድ ወደ እኛ ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም እንደ መጡ ንጉሡ ይወቅ፤ ዓመፀኛይቱንና እጅግም የከፋቺቱን ከተማ ይሠራሉ፥ ቅጥርዋንም ያድሳሉ፥ መሠረትዋንም ጠገኑ።

verses.en: Be it known now unto the king, that, if this city be builded, and the walls set up again, then will they not pay toll, tribute, and custom, and so thou shalt endamage the revenue of the kings.
verses.fr: Que le roi sache donc que, si cette ville est rebâtie et si ses murs sont relevés, ils ne paieront ni tribut, ni impôt, ni droit de passage, et que le trésor royal en souffrira.
verses.am: አሁንም ይህች ከተማ የተሠራች እንደ ሆነ፥ ቅጥርዋም የታደሰ እንደ ሆነ፥ ግብርና ቀረጥ መጥንም እንዳይሰጡ፥ የንጉሡም ግቢው እንዲጐድል ንጉሡ ይወቅ።

verses.en: Now because we have maintenance from the king's palace, and it was not meet for us to see the king's dishonour, therefore have we sent and certified the king;
verses.fr: Or, comme nous mangeons le sel du palais et qu''il ne nous paraît pas convenable de voir mépriser le roi, nous envoyons au roi ces informations.
verses.am: የንጉሡንም ጨው እንበላለንና፥ ንጉሡንም ሲያቃልሉት ማየት አይገባንምና ስለዚህ ልከን ለንጉሡ አስታውቀናል፤

verses.en: That search may be made in the book of the records of thy fathers: so shalt thou find in the book of the records, and know that this city is a rebellious city, and hurtful unto kings and provinces, and that they have moved sedition within the same of old time: for which cause was this city destroyed.
verses.fr: Qu''on fasse des recherches dans le livre des mémoires de tes pères; et tu trouveras et verras dans le livre des mémoires que cette ville est une ville rebelle, funeste aux rois et aux provinces, et qu''on s''y est livré à la révolte dès les temps anciens. C''est pourquoi cette ville a été détruite.
verses.am: በአባቶችህ ታሪክ መጽሐፍ ምርመራ ይደረግ፤ በዚያም በታሪክ መጽሐፍ ይህች ከተማ ዓመፀኛ እንደ ሆነች፥ ነገሥታትንና አውራጃዎችንም እንደ ጐዳች፥ ከጥንቱም ሽፍትነት በእርስዋ እንደ ተጀመረ ታገኛለህ፥ ታውቃለህም፤ ስለዚህም ይህች ከተማ ፈርሳ ነበር።

verses.en: We certify the king that, if this city be builded again, and the walls thereof set up, by this means thou shalt have no portion on this side the river.
verses.fr: Nous faisons savoir au roi que, si cette ville est rebâtie et si ses murs sont relevés, par cela même tu n''auras plus de possession de ce côté du fleuve.
verses.am: ይህችም ከተማ የተሠራች እንደ ሆነ፥ ቅጥርዋም የታደሰ እንደ ሆነ፥ በወንዝ ማዶ ክፍል እንደሌለህ ለንጉሡ እናስታውቃለን።

verses.en: Then sent the king an answer unto Rehum the chancellor, and to Shimshai the scribe, and to the rest of their companions that dwell in Samaria, and unto the rest beyond the river, Peace, and at such a time.
verses.fr: Réponse envoyée par le roi à Rehum, gouverneur, à Schimschaï, secrétaire, et au reste de leurs collègues, demeurant à Samarie et autres lieux de l''autre côté du fleuve: Salut, etc.
verses.am: ንጉሡም ለአዛዡ ለሬሁም፥ ለጸሐፊውም ለሲምሳይ፥ በሰማርያና በወንዝ ማዶም ለተቀመጡ ለቀሩት ተባባሪዎቻቸው እንዲህ የሚለውን መልስ ላከ።

verses.en: The letter which ye sent unto us hath been plainly read before me.
verses.fr: La lettre que vous nous avez envoyée a été lue exactement devant moi.
verses.am: ሰላም፤ አሁንም ወደ እኛ የላካችሁት ደብዳቤ በፊቴ ተተርጕሞ ተነበበ።

verses.en: And I commanded, and search hath been made, and it is found that this city of old time hath made insurrection against kings, and that rebellion and sedition have been made therein.
verses.fr: J''ai donné ordre de faire des recherches; et l''on a trouvé que dès les temps anciens cette ville s''est soulevée contre les rois, et qu''on s''y est livré à la sédition et à la révolte.
verses.am: እኔም አዝዣለሁ፥ ተመረመረም፤ ይህችም ከተማ ከጥንት ጀምራ በነገሥታት ላይ ዓመፀኛ እንደ ነበረች፥ በእርስዋም ዓመፅና ሽፍትነት እንደ ተደረገ ተገኘ።

verses.en: There have been mighty kings also over Jerusalem, which have ruled over all countries beyond the river; and toll, tribute, and custom, was paid unto them.
verses.fr: Il y eut à Jérusalem des rois puissants, maîtres de tout le pays de l''autre côté du fleuve, et auxquels on payait tribut, impôt, et droit de passage.
verses.am: በኢየሩሳሌምም እጅግ ኃያላን ነገሥታት ነበሩ፥ በወንዝም ማዶ ያለውን አገር ሁሉ ይገዙ ነበር፤ ግብርንና ቀረጥን መጥንንም ይቀበሉ ነበር።

verses.en: Give ye now commandment to cause these men to cease, and that this city be not builded, until another commandment shall be given from me.
verses.fr: En conséquence, ordonnez de faire cesser les travaux de ces gens, afin que cette ville ne se rebâtisse point avant une autorisation de ma part.
verses.am: አሁንም እነዚህ ሰዎች ሥራውን እንዲተዉ፥ እኔም እስካዝዝ ድረስ ይህች ከተማ እንዳትሠራ ትእዛዝ ስጡ።

verses.en: Take heed now that ye fail not to do this: why should damage grow to the hurt of the kings?
verses.fr: Gardez-vous de mettre en cela de la négligence, de peur que le mal n''augmente au préjudice des rois.
verses.am: ቸልም እንዳትሉ ተጠንቀቁ፤ ለነገሥታቱ ጉዳትና ጥፋት እየበዛ ስለ ምን ይሄዳል?

verses.en: Now when the copy of king Artaxerxes' letter was read before Rehum, and Shimshai the scribe, and their companions, they went up in haste to Jerusalem unto the Jews, and made them to cease by force and power.
verses.fr: Aussitôt que la copie de la lettre du roi Artaxerxès eut été lue devant Rehum, Schimschaï, le secrétaire, et leurs collègues, ils allèrent en hâte à Jérusalem vers les Juifs, et firent cesser leurs travaux par violence et par force.
verses.am: የንጉሡም የአርጤክስስ ደብዳቤ ግልባጭ በሬሁምና በጸሐፊው በሲምሳይ በተባባሪዎቻቸውም ፊት በተነበበ ጊዜ ፈጥነው ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም ወደ አይሁድ ሄዱ፤ በግድና በኃይልም አስተዉአቸው።

verses.en: Then ceased the work of the house of God which is at Jerusalem. So it ceased unto the second year of the reign of Darius king of Persia.
verses.fr: Alors s''arrêta l''ouvrage de la maison de Dieu à Jérusalem, et il fut interrompu jusqu''à la seconde année du règne de Darius, roi de Perse.
verses.am: በዚያን ጊዜም በኢየሩሳሌም ያለው የእግዚአብሔር ቤት ሥራ ቀረ፤ እስከ ፋርስም ንጉሥ እስከ ዳርዮስ መንግሥት እስከ ሁለተኛው ዓመት ድረስ ተጓጐለ።

verses.en: Then the prophets, Haggai the prophet, and Zechariah the son of Iddo, prophesied unto the Jews that were in Judah and Jerusalem in the name of the God of Israel, even unto them.
verses.fr: Aggée, le prophète, et Zacharie, fils d''Iddo, le prophète, prophétisèrent aux Juifs qui étaient en Juda et à Jérusalem, au nom du Dieu d''Israël.
verses.am: ነቢያቱም ሐጌና የአዶ ልጅ ዘካርያስ በይሁዳና በኢየሩሳሌም ለነበሩ አይሁድ በእስራኤል አምላክ ስም ትንቢት ተናገሩላቸው።

verses.en: Then rose up Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, and Jeshua the son of Jozadak, and began to build the house of God which is at Jerusalem: and with them were the prophets of God helping them.
verses.fr: Alors Zorobabel, fils de Schealthiel, et Josué, fils de Jotsadak, se levèrent et commencèrent à bâtir la maison de Dieu à Jérusalem. Et avec eux étaient les prophètes de Dieu, qui les assistaient.
verses.am: በዚያን ጊዜ የሰላትያል ልጅ ዘሩባቤል የኢዮሴዴቅም ልጅ ኢያሱ ተነሥተው በኢየሩሳሌም ያለውን የእግዚአብሔርን ቤት መሥራት ጀመሩ፤ የሚያግዙአቸውም የእግዚአብሔር ነቢያት ከእነርሱ ጋር ነበሩ።

verses.en: At the same time came to them Tatnai, governor on this side the river, and Shetharboznai and their companions, and said thus unto them, Who hath commanded you to build this house, and to make up this wall?
verses.fr: Dans ce même temps, Thathnaï, gouverneur de ce côté du fleuve, Schethar-Boznaï, et leurs collègues, vinrent auprès d''eux et leur parlèrent ainsi: Qui vous a donné l''autorisation de bâtir cette maison et de relever ces murs?
verses.am: በዚያም ዘመን በወንዝ ማዶ የነበረው ገዥ ተንትናይ፥ ደግሞ ሰተርቡዝናይ፥ ተባባሪዎቻቸውም ወደ እነርሱ መጥተው። ይህን ቤት ትሠሩ ዘንድ፥ ይህንኑም ቅጥር ታድሱ ዘንድ ያዘዛችሁ ማን ነው? አሉአቸው።

verses.en: Then said we unto them after this manner, What are the names of the men that make this building?
verses.fr: Ils leur dirent encore: Quels sont les noms des hommes qui construisent cet édifice?
verses.am: ደግሞም። ይህንስ ሥራ የሚሠሩት ሰዎች ስም ማን ነው? ብለው ጠየቁአቸው።

verses.en: But the eye of their God was upon the elders of the Jews, that they could not cause them to cease, till the matter came to Darius: and then they returned answer by letter concerning this matter.
verses.fr: Mais l''oeil de Dieu veillait sur les anciens des Juifs. Et on laissa continuer les travaux pendant l''envoi d''un rapport à Darius et jusqu''à la réception d''une lettre sur cet objet.
verses.am: የአምላካቸው ዓይን ግን በአይሁድ ሽማግሌዎች ላይ ነበረ፥ ይህም ነገር ወደ ዳርዮስ እስኪደርስ ድረስ፥ መልሱም በደብዳቤ እስኪመጣ ድረስ አልከለከሉአቸውም።

verses.en: The copy of the letter that Tatnai, governor on this side the river, and Shetharboznai and his companions the Apharsachites, which were on this side the river, sent unto Darius the king:
verses.fr: Copie de la lettre envoyée au roi Darius par Thathnaï, gouverneur de ce côté du fleuve. Schethar-Boznaï, et leurs collègues d''Apharsac, demeurant de ce côté du fleuve.
verses.am: በወንዙ ማዶ የነበረው ገዥ ተንትናይ ደግሞ ሰተርቡዝናይ ተባባሪዎቹም በወንዙ ማዶ የነበሩት አፈርስካውያን ወደ ንጉሡ ወደ ዳርዮስ የላኩት የደብዳቤው ግልባጭ ይህ ነበረ።

verses.en: They sent a letter unto him, wherein was written thus; Unto Darius the king, all peace.
verses.fr: Ils lui adressèrent un rapport ainsi conçu: Au roi Darius, salut!
verses.am: እንዲህም የሚል ደብዳቤ ላኩለት። ለንጉሡ ለዳርዮስ ሙሉ ሰላም ይሁን፤

verses.en: Be it known unto the king, that we went into the province of Judea, to the house of the great God, which is builded with great stones, and timber is laid in the walls, and this work goeth fast on, and prospereth in their hands.
verses.fr: Que le roi sache que nous sommes allés dans la province de Juda, à la maison du grand Dieu. Elle se construit en pierres de taille, et le bois se pose dans les murs; le travail marche rapidement et réussit entre leurs mains.
verses.am: ወደ ይሁዳ አገር ወደ ታላቁም አምላክ ቤት እንደ ሄድን ንጉሡ ይወቅ፤ እርሱም በትልቅ ድንጋይ ተሠራ፥ በቅጥሩም ውስጥ እንጨት ተደረገ፥ ያም ሥራ በትጋት ይሠራል፥ በእጃቸውም ይከናወናል።

verses.en: Then asked we those elders, and said unto them thus, Who commanded you to build this house, and to make up these walls?
verses.fr: Nous avons interrogé les anciens, et nous leur avons ainsi parlé: Qui vous a donné l''autorisation de bâtir cette maison et de relever ces murs?
verses.am: እነዚያንም ሽማግሌዎች። ይህን ቤት ትሠሩ ዘንድ፥ ይህንስ ቅጥር ታድሱ ዘንድ ያዘዛችሁ ማን ነው? ብለን ጠየቅናቸው።

verses.en: We asked their names also, to certify thee, that we might write the names of the men that were the chief of them.
verses.fr: Nous leur avons aussi demandé leurs noms pour te les faire connaître, et nous avons mis par écrit les noms des hommes qui sont à leur tête.
verses.am: ደግሞም እናስታውቅህ ዘንድ፥ በእነርሱም ያሉትን ሹሞች ስም እንጽፍልህ ዘንድ ስማቸውን ጠየቅን።

verses.en: And thus they returned us answer, saying, We are the servants of the God of heaven and earth, and build the house that was builded these many years ago, which a great king of Israel builded and set up.
verses.fr: Voici la réponse qu''ils nous ont faite: Nous sommes les serviteurs du Dieu des cieux et de la terre, et nous rebâtissons la maison qui avait été construite il y a bien des années; un grand roi d''Israël l''avait bâtie et achevée.
verses.am: እንደዚህም ብለው መለሱልን። እኛ የሰማይና የምድር አምላክ ባሪያዎች ነን፥ ከብዙም ዘመን ጀምሮ ተሠርቶ የነበረውን፥ ታላቁም የእስራኤል ንጉሥ ሠርቶ የፈጸመውን ቤት እንሠራለን።

verses.en: But after that our fathers had provoked the God of heaven unto wrath, he gave them into the hand of Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon, the Chaldean, who destroyed this house, and carried the people away into Babylon.
verses.fr: Mais après que nos pères eurent irrité le Dieu des cieux, il les livra entre les mains de Nebucadnetsar, roi de Babylone, le Chaldéen, qui détruisit cette maison et emmena le peuple captif à Babylone.
verses.am: አባቶቻችንም የሰማይን አምላክ ካስቈጡ በኋላ በከለዳዊው በባቢሎን ንጉሥ በናቡከደነፆር እጅ አሳልፎ ሰጣቸው፥ እርሱም ይህን ቤት አፈረሰ፥ ሕዝቡንም ወደ ባቢሎን አፈለሰ።

verses.en: But in the first year of Cyrus the king of Babylon the same king Cyrus made a decree to build this house of God.
verses.fr: Toutefois, la première année de Cyrus, roi de Babylone, le roi Cyrus donna l''ordre de rebâtir cette maison de Dieu.
verses.am: ነገር ግን በባቢሎን ንጉሥ በቂሮስ በመጀመሪያው ዓመት ንጉሡ ቂሮስ ይህን የእግዚአብሔርን ቤት ይሠሩ ዘንድ አዘዘ።

verses.en: And the vessels also of gold and silver of the house of God, which Nebuchadnezzar took out of the temple that was in Jerusalem, and brought them into the temple of Babylon, those did Cyrus the king take out of the temple of Babylon, and they were delivered unto one, whose name was Sheshbazzar, whom he had made governor;
verses.fr: Et même le roi Cyrus ôta du temple de Babylone les ustensiles d''or et d''argent de la maison de Dieu, que Nebucadnetsar avait enlevés du temple de Jérusalem et transportés dans le temple de Babylone, il les fit remettre au nommé Scheschbatsar, qu''il établit gouverneur,
verses.am: ናቡከደነፆርም በኢየሩሳሌም ከነበረው መቅደስ የወሰደውን፥ ወደ ባቢሎንም መቅደስ ያፈለሰውን የእግዚአብሔርን ቤት የወርቅንና የብርን ዕቃ ንጉሡ ቂሮስ ከባቢሎን መቅደስ አውጥቶ ሰሳብሳር ለተባለው ለሹሙ ሰጠውና።

verses.en: And said unto him, Take these vessels, go, carry them into the temple that is in Jerusalem, and let the house of God be builded in his place.
verses.fr: et il lui dit: Prends ces ustensiles, va les déposer dans le temple de Jérusalem, et que la maison de Dieu soit rebâtie sur le lieu où elle était.
verses.am: ይህን ዕቃ ይዘህ ሂድ፥ በኢየሩሳሌምም ባለው መቅደስ አኑረው፤ የእግዚአብሔርም ቤት በስፍራው ይሠራ አለው።

verses.en: Then came the same Sheshbazzar, and laid the foundation of the house of God which is in Jerusalem: and since that time even until now hath it been in building, and yet it is not finished.
verses.fr: Ce Scheschbatsar est donc venu, et il a posé les fondements de la maison de Dieu à Jérusalem; depuis lors jusqu''à présent elle se construit, et elle n''est pas achevée.
verses.am: በዚያ ጊዜም ይህ ሰሳብሳር መጣ፥ በኢየሩሳሌምም ያለውን የእግዚአብሔርን ቤት መሠረተ፤ ከዚያም ጊዜ ጀምሮ እስከ ዛሬ ድረስ እየተሠራ አልተጨረሰም።

verses.en: Now therefore, if it seem good to the king, let there be search made in the king's treasure house, which is there at Babylon, whether it be so, that a decree was made of Cyrus the king to build this house of God at Jerusalem, and let the king send his pleasure to us concerning this matter.
verses.fr: Maintenant, si le roi le trouve bon, que l''on fasse des recherches dans la maison des trésors du roi à Babylone, pour voir s''il y a eu de la part du roi Cyrus un ordre donné pour la construction de cette maison de Dieu à Jérusalem. Puis, que le roi nous transmette sa volonté sur cet objet.
verses.am: አሁንም ይህ ነገር በንጉሡ ዓይን መልካም ቢሆን ይህ የእግዚአብሔር ቤት በኢየሩሳሌም ይሠራ ዘንድ ከንጉሡ ከቂሮስ ታዝዞ እንደ ሆነ በባቢሎን ባለው በንጉሡ ቤተ መዛግብት ይመርመር፤ ስለዚህም ነገር ንጉሡ ፈቃዱን ይላክልን።

verses.en: Then Darius the king made a decree, and search was made in the house of the rolls, where the treasures were laid up in Babylon.
verses.fr: Alors le roi Darius donna ordre de faire des recherches dans la maison des archives où l''on déposait les trésors à Babylone.
verses.am: በዚያ ጊዜም ንጉሡ ዳርዮስ መዛግብት ባሉበት በባቢሎን ቤተ መጻሕፍት እንዲመረመር አዘዘ።

verses.en: And there was found at Achmetha, in the palace that is in the province of the Medes, a roll, and therein was a record thus written:
verses.fr: Et l''on trouva à Achmetha, capitale de la province de Médie, un rouleau sur lequel était écrit le mémoire suivant:
verses.am: በሜዶን አውራጃ ባለው አሕምታ በሚባል ከተማ በንጉሡ ቤት ውስጥ አንድ ጥቅልል ተገኘ፥ በውስጡም ይህ ነገር ለመታሰቢያ ተጽፎ ነበር።

verses.en: In the first year of Cyrus the king the same Cyrus the king made a decree concerning the house of God at Jerusalem, Let the house be builded, the place where they offered sacrifices, and let the foundations thereof be strongly laid; the height thereof threescore cubits, and the breadth thereof threescore cubits;
verses.fr: La première année du roi Cyrus, le roi Cyrus a donné cet ordre au sujet de la maison de Dieu à Jérusalem: Que la maison soit rebâtie, pour être un lieu où l''on offre des sacrifices, et qu''elle ait des solides fondements. Elle aura soixante coudées de hauteur, soixante coudées de largeur,
verses.am: በንጉሡ በቂሮስ በመጀመሪያው ዓመት ንጉሡ ቂሮስ እንዲህ ብሎ አዘዘ፤ በኢየሩሳሌም ያለው የእግዚአብሔር ቤት፥ መሥዋዕት የሚቀርብበት ቦታ፥ ይህ ቤት ይሠራ፥ በጽኑም ይመሥረት፤ ቁመቱ ስድሳ ክንድ ወርዱም ስድሳ ክንድ ይሁን።

verses.en: With three rows of great stones, and a row of new timber: and let the expenses be given out of the king's house:
verses.fr: trois rangées de pierres de taille et une rangée de bois neuf. Les frais seront payés par la maison du roi.
verses.am: በሦስት ተራ ታላላቅ ድንጋይ፥ በአንድ ተራ እንጨት ይደረግ፤ ውጪውም ከንጉሡ ቤት ይሰጥ።

verses.en: And also let the golden and silver vessels of the house of God, which Nebuchadnezzar took forth out of the temple which is at Jerusalem, and brought unto Babylon, be restored, and brought again unto the temple which is at Jerusalem, every one to his place, and place them in the house of God.
verses.fr: De plus, les ustensiles d''or et d''argent de la maison de Dieu, que Nebucadnetsar avait enlevés du temple de Jérusalem et transportés à Babylone, seront rendus, transportés au temple de Jérusalem à la place où ils étaient, et déposés dans la maison de Dieu.
verses.am: ናቡከደነፆርም በኢየሩሳሌም ካለው መቅደስ ወስዶ ወደ ባቢሎን ያመጣው የእግዚአብሔር ቤት የወርቅና የብር ዕቃ ይመለስ፤ በኢየሩሳሌምም ወዳለው መቅደስ ወደ ስፍራው ይወሰድ፥ በእግዚአብሔር ቤት ይኑር።

verses.en: Now therefore, Tatnai, governor beyond the river, Shetharboznai, and your companions the Apharsachites, which are beyond the river, be ye far from thence:
verses.fr: Maintenant, Thathnaï, gouverneur de l''autre côté du fleuve, Schethar-Boznaï, et vos collègues d''Apharsac, qui demeurez de l''autre côté du fleuve, tenez-vous loin de ce lieu.
verses.am: አሁንም አንተ በወንዝ ማዶ ያለኸው የአገሩ ገዥ ተንትናይ ደግሞ ሰተርቡዝናይ በወንዝ ማዶም ያሉ ተባባሪዎቻችሁ አፈርስካውያን፥ ከዚያ ራቁ፤

verses.en: Let the work of this house of God alone; let the governor of the Jews and the elders of the Jews build this house of God in his place.
verses.fr: Laissez continuer les travaux de cette maison de Dieu; que le gouverneur des Juifs et les anciens des Juifs la rebâtissent sur l''emplacement qu''elle occupait.
verses.am: ይህም የእግዚአብሔር ቤት ይሠራ ዘንድ ተዉ፤ የአይሁድም አለቃና የአይሁድም ሽማግሌዎች ይህን የእግዚአብሔርን ቤት በስፍራው ይሠሩ ዘንድ ተዉአቸው።

verses.en: Moreover I make a decree what ye shall do to the elders of these Jews for the building of this house of God: that of the king's goods, even of the tribute beyond the river, forthwith expenses be given unto these men, that they be not hindered.
verses.fr: Voici l''ordre que je donne touchant ce que vous aurez à faire à l''égard de ces anciens des Juifs pour la construction de cette maison de Dieu: les frais, pris sur les biens du roi provenant des tributs de l''autre côté du fleuve, seront exactement payés à ces hommes, afin qu''il n''y ait pas d''interruption.
verses.am: ይህን የእግዚአብሔርን ቤት ይሠሩ ዘንድ ለአይሁድ ሽማግሌዎች የምታደርጉትን፥ በወንዝ ማዶ ካለው አገር ከሚመጣው ግብር ከንጉሡ ገንዘብ ለእነዚህ ሰዎች ወጪውን በትጋት እንድትሰጡአቸው ሥራም እንዳታስፈቱአቸው አዝዣለሁ።

verses.en: And that which they have need of, both young bullocks, and rams, and lambs, for the burnt offerings of the God of heaven, wheat, salt, wine, and oil, according to the appointment of the priests which are at Jerusalem, let it be given them day by day without fail:
verses.fr: Les choses nécessaires pour les holocaustes du Dieu des cieux, jeunes taureaux, béliers et agneaux, froment, sel, vin et huile, seront livrées, sur leur demande, aux sacrificateurs de Jérusalem, jour par jour et sans manquer,
verses.am: ለሰማይ አምላክ ለሚቃጠል መሥዋዕት የሚያስፈልገውን፥ ወይፈኖችና አውራ በጎች ጠቦቶችም፥ በኢየሩሳሌምም እንዳሉ እንደ ካህናቱ ቃል ስንዴና ጨው የወይን ጠጅና ዘይት ዕለት ዕለት ያለማቋረጥ ስጡአቸው።

verses.en: That they may offer sacrifices of sweet savours unto the God of heaven, and pray for the life of the king, and of his sons.
verses.fr: afin qu''ils offrent des sacrifices de bonne odeur au Dieu des cieux et qu''ils prient pour la vie du roi et de ses fils.
verses.am: ይኸውም ለሰማይ አምላክ ጣፋጭ ሽቱ የሆነውን መሥዋዕት ያቀረቡ ዘንድ ለንጉሡና ለልጆቹም ዕድሜ ይጸልዩ ዘንድ ነው።

verses.en: Also I have made a decree, that whosoever shall alter this word, let timber be pulled down from his house, and being set up, let him be hanged thereon; and let his house be made a dunghill for this.
verses.fr: Et voici l''ordre que je donne touchant quiconque transgressera cette parole: on arrachera de sa maison une pièce de bois, on la dressera pour qu''il y soit attaché, et l''on fera de sa maison un tas d''immondices.
verses.am: ይህንም ትእዛዝ የሚለውጥ ሁሉ፥ ምሰሶው ከቤቱ ተነቅሎ እርሱ ይሰቀልበት፤ ቤቱም የጉድፍ መጣያ ይደረግ ብዬ አዝዣለሁ።

verses.en: And the God that hath caused his name to dwell there destroy all kings and people, that shall put to their hand to alter and to destroy this house of God which is at Jerusalem. I Darius have made a decree; let it be done with speed.
verses.fr: Que le Dieu qui fait résider en ce lieu son nom renverse tout roi et tout peuple qui étendraient la main pour transgresser ma parole, pour détruire cette maison de Dieu à Jérusalem! Moi, Darius, j''ai donné cet ordre. Qu''il soit ponctuellement exécuté.
verses.am: ስሙንም በዚያ ያኖረው አምላክ ይህን ይለውጡ ዘንድ በኢየሩሳሌም ያለውንም የእግዚአብሔርን ቤት ያፈርሱት ዘንድ እጃቸውን የሚዘረጉትን ነገሥታትና አሕዛብ ሁሉ ያጥፋ። እኔ ዳርዮስ ይህን አዝዣለሁ፤ በትጋት ይፈጸም።

verses.en: Then Tatnai, governor on this side the river, Shetharboznai, and their companions, according to that which Darius the king had sent, so they did speedily.
verses.fr: Thathnaï, gouverneur de ce côté du fleuve, Schethar-Boznaï, et leurs collègues, se conformèrent ponctuellement à cet ordre que leur envoya le roi Darius.
verses.am: ንጉሡም ዳርዮስ እንደ ላከው ቃል፥ በዚያን ጊዜ በወንዝ ማዶ ያለ ገዥ ተንትናይ ደግሞ ሰተርቡዝናይ ተባባሪዎቻቸውም እንዲሁ ተግተው አደረጉ።

verses.en: And the elders of the Jews builded, and they prospered through the prophesying of Haggai the prophet and Zechariah the son of Iddo. And they builded, and finished it, according to the commandment of the God of Israel, and according to the commandment of Cyrus, and Darius, and Artaxerxes king of Persia.
verses.fr: Et les anciens des Juifs bâtirent avec succès, selon les prophéties d''Aggée, le prophète, et de Zacharie, fils d''Iddo; ils bâtirent et achevèrent, d''après l''ordre du Dieu d''Israël, et d''après l''ordre de Cyrus, de Darius, et d''Artaxerxès, roi de Perse.
verses.am: የአይሁድም ሽማግሌዎች በነቢዩ በሐጌና በአዶ ልጅ በዘካርያስ ትንቢት ሠሩ ተከናወነላቸውም። እንደ እስራኤልም አምላክ ትእዛዝ፥ እንደ ፋርስም ነገሥታት እንደ ቂሮስና እንደ ዳርዮስ እንደ አርጤክስስም ትእዛዝ ሠርተው ፈጸሙ።

verses.en: And this house was finished on the third day of the month Adar, which was in the sixth year of the reign of Darius the king.
verses.fr: La maison fut achevée le troisième jour du mois d''Adar, dans la sixième année du règne du roi Darius.
verses.am: ይህም ቤት በንጉሡ በዳርዮስ መንግሥት በስድስተኛው ዓመት አዳር በሚባል ወር በሦስተኛው ቀን ተፈጸመ።

verses.en: And the children of Israel, the priests, and the Levites, and the rest of the children of the captivity, kept the dedication of this house of God with joy.
verses.fr: Les enfants d''Israël, les sacrificateurs et les Lévites, et le reste des fils de la captivité, firent avec joie la dédicace de cette maison de Dieu.
verses.am: የእስራኤልም ልጆች፥ ካህናትና ሌዋውያን የቀሩትም ምርኮኞች፥ የዚህን የእግዚአብሔርን ቤት ቅዳሴ በደስታ አደረጉ።

verses.en: And offered at the dedication of this house of God an hundred bullocks, two hundred rams, four hundred lambs; and for a sin offering for all Israel, twelve he goats, according to the number of the tribes of Israel.
verses.fr: Ils offrirent, pour la dédicace de cette maison de Dieu, cent taureaux, deux cents béliers, quatre cents agneaux, et, comme victimes expiatoires pour tout Israël, douze boucs, d''après le nombre des tribus d''Israël.
verses.am: በዚህም በእግዚአብሔር ቤት ቅዳሴ መቶ ወይፈኖችና ሁለት መቶ አውራ በጎች አራት መቶም ጠቦቶች አቀረቡ ፤ ስለ ኃጢአትም መሥዋዕት እንደ እስራኤል ነገዶች ቍጥር ለእስራኤል ሁሉ አሥራ ሁለት አውራ ፍየሎች አቀረቡ።

verses.en: And they set the priests in their divisions, and the Levites in their courses, for the service of God, which is at Jerusalem; as it is written in the book of Moses.
verses.fr: Ils établirent les sacrificateurs selon leurs classes et les Lévites selon leurs divisions pour le service de Dieu à Jérusalem, comme il est écrit dans le livre de Moïse.
verses.am: በሙሴም መጽሐፍ እንደ ተጻፈው በኢየሩሳሌም ባለው በእግዚአብሔር አገልግሎት ላይ ካህናቱን በየማዕርጋቸው ሌዋውያኑም በየክፍላቸው አቆሙ።

verses.en: And the children of the captivity kept the passover upon the fourteenth day of the first month.
verses.fr: Les fils de la captivité célébrèrent la Pâque le quatorzième jour du premier mois.
verses.am: ምርኮኞቹም በመጀመሪያው ወር በአሥራ አራተኛው ቀን ፋሲካውን አደረጉ።

verses.en: For the priests and the Levites were purified together, all of them were pure, and killed the passover for all the children of the captivity, and for their brethren the priests, and for themselves.
verses.fr: Les sacrificateurs et les Lévites s''étaient purifiés de concert, tous étaient purs; ils immolèrent la Pâque pour tous les fils de la captivité, pour leurs frères les sacrificateurs, et pour eux-mêmes.
verses.am: ካህናቱና ሌዋውያኑም አንድ ሆነው ነጽተው ነበር፤ ሁሉም ንጹሐን ነበሩ፤ ለምርኮኞቹም ሁሉ፥ ለወንድሞቻቸውም ለካህናቱ፥ ለራሳቸውም ፋሲካውን አረዱ።

verses.en: And the children of Israel, which were come again out of captivity, and all such as had separated themselves unto them from the filthiness of the heathen of the land, to seek the Lord God of Israel, did eat,
verses.fr: Les enfants d''Israël revenus de la captivité mangèrent la Pâque, avec tous ceux qui s''étaient éloignés de l''impureté des nations du pays et qui se joignirent à eux pour chercher l''Eternel, le Dieu d''Israël.
verses.am: ከምርኮም ተመልሰው የመጡት የእስራኤል ልጆች፥ የእስራኤልንም አምላክ እግዚአብሔርን ይፈልጉ ዘንድ ራሳቸውን ከምድር አሕዛብ ርኵሰት ለይተው ወደ እነርሱ መጥተው የነበሩት ሁሉ በሉ፤

verses.en: And kept the feast of unleavened bread seven days with joy: for the Lord had made them joyful, and turned the heart of the king of Assyria unto them, to strengthen their hands in the work of the house of God, the God of Israel.
verses.fr: Ils célébrèrent avec joie pendant sept jours la fête des pains sans levain, car l''Eternel les avait réjouis en disposant le roi d''Assyrie à les soutenir dans l''oeuvre de la maison de Dieu, du Dieu d''Israël.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ደስ አሰኝቶአቸዋልና፥ የእስራኤልንም አምላክ የእግዚአብሔርን ቤት ለመሥራት እጃቸውን ያጸና ዘንድ የአሦርን ንጉሥ ልብ ወደ እነርሱ መልሶአልና የቂጣውን በዓል ሰባት ቀን በደስታ አደረጉ።

verses.en: Now after these things, in the reign of Artaxerxes king of Persia, Ezra the son of Seraiah, the son of Azariah, the son of Hilkiah,
verses.fr: Après ces choses, sous le règne d''Artaxerxès, roi de Perse, vint Esdras, fils de Seraja, fils d''Azaria, fils de Hilkija,
verses.am: ከዚህም ነገር በኋላ በፋርስ ንጉሥ በአርጤክስስ መንግሥት ዕዝራ የሠራያ ልጅ፥

verses.en: The son of Shallum, the son of Zadok, the son of Ahitub,
verses.fr: fils de Schallum, fils de Tsadok, fils d''Achithub,
verses.am: የዓዛርያስ ልጅ፥ የኬልቅያስ ልጅ፥ የሰሎም ልጅ፥ የሳዶቅ ልጅ፥ የአኪጦብ ልጅ፥

verses.en: The son of Amariah, the son of Azariah, the son of Meraioth,
verses.fr: fils d''Amaria, fils d''Azaria, fils de Merajoth,
verses.am: የአማርያ ልጅ፥ የዓዛርያስ ልጅ፥ የመራዮት ልጅ፥

verses.en: The son of Zerahiah, the son of Uzzi, the son of Bukki,
verses.fr: fils de Zerachja, fils d''Uzzi, fils de Bukki,
verses.am: የዘራእያ ልጅ፥ የኦዚ ልጅ፥ የቡቂ ልጅ፥

verses.en: The son of Abishua, the son of Phinehas, the son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron the chief priest:
verses.fr: fils d''Abischua, fils de Phinées, fils d''Eléazar, fils d''Aaron, le souverain sacrificateur.
verses.am: የአቢሱ ልጅ፥ የፊንሐስ ልጅ፥ የአልዓዛር ልጅ፥ የታላቁ ካህን የአሮን ልጅ፥ ይህ ዕዝራ ከባቢሎን ወጣ፤

verses.en: This Ezra went up from Babylon; and he was a ready scribe in the law of Moses, which the Lord God of Israel had given: and the king granted him all his request, according to the hand of the Lord his God upon him.
verses.fr: Cet Esdras vint de Babylone: c''était un scribe versé dans la loi de Moïse, donnée par l''Eternel, le Dieu d''Israël. Et comme la main de l''Eternel, son Dieu, était sur lui, le roi lui accorda tout ce qu''il avait demandé.
verses.am: የእስራኤልም አምላክ እግዚአብሔር በሰጠው በሙሴ ሕግ ፈጣን ጸሐፊ ነበረ፤ የአምላኩም የእግዚአብሔር እጅ በእርሱ ላይ ነበረችና ንጉሡ የሻውን ሁሉ ሰጠው።

verses.en: And there went up some of the children of Israel, and of the priests, and the Levites, and the singers, and the porters, and the Nethinims, unto Jerusalem, in the seventh year of Artaxerxes the king.
verses.fr: Plusieurs des enfants d''Israël, des sacrificateurs et des Lévites, des chantres, des portiers, et des Néthiniens, vinrent aussi à Jérusalem, la septième année du roi Artaxerxès.
verses.am: ከእስራኤልም ልጆች ከካህናቱም ከሌዋውያኑም ከመዘምራኑም ከበረኞቹም ከናታኒምም በንጉሡ በአርጤክስስ በሰባተኛው ዓመት አያሌዎች ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም ወጡ።

verses.en: And he came to Jerusalem in the fifth month, which was in the seventh year of the king.
verses.fr: Esdras arriva à Jérusalem au cinquième mois de la septième année du roi;
verses.am: በንጉሡም በሰባተኛው ዓመት በአምስተኛው ወር ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም ደረሰ።

verses.en: For upon the first day of the first month began he to go up from Babylon, and on the first day of the fifth month came he to Jerusalem, according to the good hand of his God upon him.
verses.fr: il était parti de Babylone le premier jour du premier mois, et il arriva à Jérusalem le premier jour du cinquième mois, la bonne main de son Dieu étant sur lui.
verses.am: በመጀመሪያውም ወር በአንደኛው ቀን ከባቢሎን ሊወጣ ጀመረ፥ መልካሚቱም የአምላኩ እጅ በእርሱ ላይ ነበረችና በአምስተኛ ወር በመጀመሪያው ቀን ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም ደረሰ።

verses.en: For Ezra had prepared his heart to seek the law of the Lord, and to do it, and to teach in Israel statutes and judgments.
verses.fr: Car Esdras avait appliqué son coeur à étudier et à mettre en pratique la loi de l''Eternel, et à enseigner au milieu d''Israël les lois et les ordonnances.
verses.am: ዕዝራም የእግዚአብሔርን ሕግ ይፈልግና ያደርግ ዘንድ፥ ለእስራኤልም ሥርዓትንና ፍርድን ያስተምር ዘንድ ልቡን አዘጋጅቶ ነበር።

verses.en: Now this is the copy of the letter that the king Artaxerxes gave unto Ezra the priest, the scribe, even a scribe of the words of the commandments of the Lord, and of his statutes to Israel.
verses.fr: Voici la copie de la lettre donnée par le roi Artaxerxès à Esdras, sacrificateur et scribe, enseignant les commandements et les lois de l''Eternel concernant Israël:
verses.am: ንጉሡም አርጤክስስ የእግዚአብሔርን ትእዛዝ ቃልና ለእስራኤል የሆነውን ሥርዓት ይጽፍ ለነበረው ለጸሐፊው ለካህኑ ለዕዝራ የሰጠው የደብዳቤው ግልባጭ ይህ ነው።

verses.en: Artaxerxes, king of kings, unto Ezra the priest, a scribe of the law of the God of heaven, perfect peace, and at such a time.
verses.fr: Artaxerxès, roi des rois, à Esdras, sacrificateur et scribe, versé dans la loi du Dieu des cieux, etc.
verses.am: ከንጉሠ ነገሥት ከአርጤክስስ ለሰማይ አምላክ ሕግ ጸሐፊ ለካህኑ ለዕዝራ፥ ሙሉ ሰላም ይሁን፤

verses.en: I make a decree, that all they of the people of Israel, and of his priests and Levites, in my realm, which are minded of their own freewill to go up to Jerusalem, go with thee.
verses.fr: J''ai donné ordre de laisser aller tous ceux du peuple d''Israël, de ses sacrificateurs et de ses Lévites, qui se trouvent dans mon royaume, et qui sont disposés à partir avec toi pour Jérusalem.
verses.am: በመንግሥቴ ውስጥ ካሉ ከእስራኤል ሕዝብ ከካህናቱና ከሌዋውያኑም ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም ይሄድ ዘንድ የሚወድድ ሁሉ ከአንተ ጋር እንዲሄድ አዝዣለሁ።

verses.en: Forasmuch as thou art sent of the king, and of his seven counsellors, to enquire concerning Judah and Jerusalem, according to the law of thy God which is in thine hand;
verses.fr: Tu es envoyé par le roi et ses sept conseillers pour inspecter Juda et Jérusalem d''après la loi de ton Dieu, laquelle est entre tes mains,
verses.am: በእጅህ እንዳለችው እንደ አምላክህ ሕግ ይሁዳንና ኢየሩሳሌምን ትጐበኝ ዘንድ፥

verses.en: And to carry the silver and gold, which the king and his counsellors have freely offered unto the God of Israel, whose habitation is in Jerusalem,
verses.fr: et pour porter l''argent et l''or que le roi et ses conseillers ont généreusement offerts au Dieu d''Israël, dont la demeure est à Jérusalem,
verses.am: ንጉሡንና አማካሪዎቹም መኖሪያው በኢየሩሳሌም ለሆነው ለእስራኤል አምላክ በፈቃዳቸው ያቀረቡትን ብርና ወርቅ፥

verses.en: And all the silver and gold that thou canst find in all the province of Babylon, with the freewill offering of the people, and of the priests, offering willingly for the house of their God which is in Jerusalem:
verses.fr: tout l''argent et l''or que tu trouveras dans toute la province de Babylone, et les dons volontaires faits par le peuple et les sacrificateurs pour la maison de leur Dieu à Jérusalem.
verses.am: በባቢሎንም አውራጃ ሁሉ የምታገኘውን ብርና ወርቅ ሁሉ፥ ሕዝቡና ካህናቱም በኢየሩሳሌም ላለው ለአምላካቸው ቤት በፈቃዳቸው የሚያቀርቡትን ትወስድ ዘንድ በንጉሡና በሰባቱ አማካሪዎች ተልከሃልና፤

verses.en: That thou mayest buy speedily with this money bullocks, rams, lambs, with their meat offerings and their drink offerings, and offer them upon the altar of the house of your God which is in Jerusalem.
verses.fr: En conséquence, tu auras soin d''acheter avec cet argent des taureaux, des béliers, des agneaux, et ce qui est nécessaire pour les offrandes et les libations, et tu les offriras sur l''autel de la maison de votre Dieu à Jérusalem.
verses.am: ስለዚህ በዚህ ገንዘብ ወደፈኖችንና አውራ በጎችን ጠቦቶችንም የእህላቸውንና የመጠጣቸውን ቍርባን ተግተህ ግዛ፤ በኢየሩሳሌምም ባለው በአምላካችሁ ቤት መሠዊያ ላይ አቅርባቸው።

verses.en: And whatsoever shall seem good to thee, and to thy brethren, to do with the rest of the silver and the gold, that do after the will of your God.
verses.fr: Vous ferez avec le reste de l''argent et de l''or ce que vous jugerez bon de faire, toi et tes frères, en vous conformant à la volonté de votre Dieu.
verses.am: ከቀረውም ብርና ወርቅ አንተና ወንድሞችህ ለማድረግ ደስ የሚያሰኛችሁን ነገር እንደ አምላካችሁ ፈቃድ አድርጉ።

verses.en: The vessels also that are given thee for the service of the house of thy God, those deliver thou before the God of Jerusalem.
verses.fr: Dépose devant le Dieu de Jérusalem les ustensiles qui te sont remis pour le service de la maison de ton Dieu.
verses.am: ስለ አምላክህም ቤት አገልግሎት የተሰጠህን ዕቃ በኢየሩሳሌም አምላክ ፊት አሳልፈህ ስጥ።

verses.en: And whatsoever more shall be needful for the house of thy God, which thou shalt have occasion to bestow, bestow it out of the king's treasure house.
verses.fr: Tu tireras de la maison des trésors du roi ce qu''il faudra pour les autres dépenses que tu auras à faire concernant la maison de ton Dieu.
verses.am: ከዚህም በላይ ለማውጣት የሚያስፈልግህን ለአምላክህ ቤት የሚያሻውን ነገር ከንጉሡ ቤተ መዛግብት አውጣ።

verses.en: And I, even I Artaxerxes the king, do make a decree to all the treasurers which are beyond the river, that whatsoever Ezra the priest, the scribe of the law of the God of heaven, shall require of you, it be done speedily,
verses.fr: Moi, le roi Artaxerxès, je donne l''ordre à tous les trésoriers de l''autre côté du fleuve de livrer exactement à Esdras, sacrificateur et scribe, versé dans la loi du Dieu des cieux, tout ce qu''il vous demandera,
verses.am: እኔም ንጉሡ አርጤክስስ በወንዝ ማዶ ላሉት በጅሮንዶች ሁሉ ይህን ትእዛዝ ሰጥቻለሁ። የሰማይ አምላክ ሕግ ጸሐፊ ካህኑ ዕዝራ ከእናንተ የሚፈልገውን ሁሉ አዘጋጁለት፤

verses.en: Unto an hundred talents of silver, and to an hundred measures of wheat, and to an hundred baths of wine, and to an hundred baths of oil, and salt without prescribing how much.
verses.fr: jusqu''à cent talents d''argent, cent cors de froment, cent baths de vin, cent baths d''huile, et du sel à discrétion.
verses.am: እስከ መቶ መክሊት ብርም ቢሆን፥ እስከ መቶ የቆሬስ መስፈሪያ ስንዴ፥ እስከ መቶም የባዶስ መስፈሪያ የወይን ጠጅ፥ እስከ መቶም የባዶስ መስፈሪያ ዘይት ቢሆን፥ ጨውም ያለ ልክ ቢሆን ስጡ።

verses.en: Whatsoever is commanded by the God of heaven, let it be diligently done for the house of the God of heaven: for why should there be wrath against the realm of the king and his sons?
verses.fr: Que tout ce qui est ordonné par le Dieu des cieux se fasse ponctuellement pour la maison du Dieu des cieux, afin que sa colère ne soit pas sur le royaume, sur le roi et sur ses fils.
verses.am: በንጉሡና በልጆቹ መንግሥት ላይ ቍጣ እንዳይሆን፥ የሰማይ አምላክ ያዘዘው ሁሉ ለሰማይ አምላክ ቤት በሙሉ ይደረግ።

verses.en: Also we certify you, that touching any of the priests and Levites, singers, porters, Nethinims, or ministers of this house of God, it shall not be lawful to impose toll, tribute, or custom, upon them.
verses.fr: Nous vous faisons savoir qu''il ne peut être levé ni tribut, ni impôt, ni droit de passage, sur aucun des sacrificateurs, des Lévites, des chantres, des portiers, des Néthiniens, et des serviteurs de cette maison de Dieu.
verses.am: ደግሞም በካህናቱና በሌዋውያን በመዘምራኑም በበረኞቹም በናታኒምም በዚህም በእግዚአብሔር ቤት በሚሠሩ አገልጋዮች ላይ ግብርና ቀረጥ መጥንም እንዳይጣል ብለን እናስታውቃችኋለን።

verses.en: And thou, Ezra, after the wisdom of thy God, that is in thine hand, set magistrates and judges, which may judge all the people that are beyond the river, all such as know the laws of thy God; and teach ye them that know them not.
verses.fr: Et toi, Esdras, selon la sagesse de Dieu que tu possèdes, établis des juges et des magistrats qui rendent la justice à tout le peuple de l''autre côté du fleuve, à tous ceux qui connaissent les lois de ton Dieu; et fais-les connaître à ceux qui ne les connaissent pas.
verses.am: አንተም ዕዝራ፥ በእጅህ እንዳለው እንደ አምላክህ ጥበብ መጠን በወንዝ ማዶ ባሉ ሕዝብ ሁሉ የአምላክህን ሕግ በሚያውቁ ሁሉ ላይ ይፈርዱ ዘንድ ዳኞችንና ፈራጆች አስነሣ፤ የማያውቁትንም አስተምሩአቸው።

verses.en: And whosoever will not do the law of thy God, and the law of the king, let judgment be executed speedily upon him, whether it be unto death, or to banishment, or to confiscation of goods, or to imprisonment.
verses.fr: Quiconque n''observera pas ponctuellement la loi de ton Dieu et la loi du roi sera condamné à la mort, au bannissement, à une amende, ou à la prison.
verses.am: የአምላክህንም ሕግ፥ የንጉሡንም ሕግ በማያደርግ ሁሉ ላይ ሞት ወይም ስደት ወይም ገንዘብን መወረስ ወይም ግዞት በፍጥነት ይፈረድበት።

verses.en: Blessed be the Lord God of our fathers, which hath put such a thing as this in the king's heart, to beautify the house of the Lord which is in Jerusalem:
verses.fr: Béni soit l''Eternel, le Dieu de nos pères, qui a disposé le coeur du roi à glorifier ainsi la maison de l''Eternel à Jérusalem,

verses.en: And hath extended mercy unto me before the king, and his counsellors, and before all the king's mighty princes. And I was strengthened as the hand of the Lord my God was upon me, and I gathered together out of Israel chief men to go up with me.
verses.fr: et qui m''a rendu l''objet de la bienveillance du roi, de ses conseillers, et de tous ses puissants chefs! Fortifié par la main de l''Eternel, mon Dieu, qui était sur moi, j''ai rassemblé les chefs d''Israël, afin qu''ils partissent avec moi.
verses.am: ፤ በኢየሩሳሌም ያለውን የእግዚአብሔርን ቤት ያሳምር ዘንድ እንደዚህ ያለውን ነገር በንጉሡ ልብ ያኖረ፥ በንጉሡም በአማካሪዎቹም በንጉሡም ኃያላን አለቆች ሁሉ ፊት ምሕረቱን ወደ እኔ የላከ የአባቶቻችን አምላክ እግዚአብሔር ይባረክ። እኔም በላዬ ባለችው በአምላኬ በእግዚአብሔር እጅ በረታሁ፤ ከእኔም ጋር እንዲወጡ ከእስራኤል ዘንድ አለቆችን ሰበሰብሁ።

verses.en: These are now the chief of their fathers, and this is the genealogy of them that went up with me from Babylon, in the reign of Artaxerxes the king.
verses.fr: Voici les chefs de familles et les généalogies de ceux qui montèrent avec moi de Babylone, sous le règne du roi Artaxerxès.
verses.am: በንጉሡ በአርጤክስስ መንግሥት ከእኔ ጋር ከባቢሎን የወጡ የአባቶች ቤቶች አለቆች እነዚህ ናቸው ትውልዳቸውም ይህ ነው፤

verses.en: Of the sons of Phinehas; Gershom: of the sons of Ithamar; Daniel: of the sons of David; Hattush.
verses.fr: Des fils de Phinées, Guerschom; des fils d''Ithamar, Daniel; des fils de David, Hatthusch,
verses.am: ከፊንሐስ ልጆች ጌርሶን፥ ከኢታምር ልጆች ዳንኤል፥ ከዳዊት ልጆች ሐጡስ፥ ከሴኬንያ ልጆች፥

verses.en: Of the sons of Shechaniah, of the sons of Pharosh; Zechariah: and with him were reckoned by genealogy of the males an hundred and fifty.
verses.fr: des fils de Schecania; des fils de Pareosch, Zacharie, et avec lui cent cinquante mâles enregistrés;
verses.am: ከፋሮስ ልጆቾ ዘካርያስ፥ ከእርሱም ጋር መቶ አምሳ ወንዶች በትውልድ ተቈጠሩ።

verses.en: Of the sons of Pahathmoab; Elihoenai the son of Zerahiah, and with him two hundred males.
verses.fr: des fils de Pachat Moab, Eljoénaï, fils de Zerachja, et avec lui deux cents mâles;
verses.am: ከፋሐት ሞዓብ ልጆች የዘራእያ ልጅ ኤሊሆዔናይ፥ ከእርሱም ጋር ሁለት መቶ ወንዶች።

verses.en: Of the sons of Shechaniah; the son of Jahaziel, and with him three hundred males.
verses.fr: des fils de Schecania, le fils de Jachaziel, et avec lui trois cents mâles;
verses.am: ከሴኬንያ ልጆች የየሕዚኤል ልጅ፥ ከእርሱም ጋር ሦስት መቶ ወንዶች።

verses.en: Of the sons also of Adin; Ebed the son of Jonathan, and with him fifty males.
verses.fr: des fils d''Adin, Ebed, fils de Jonathan, et avec lui cinquante mâles;
verses.am: ከዓዲን ልጆች የዮናታን ልጅ ዔቤድ፥ ከእርሱም ጋር አምሳ ወንዶች።

verses.en: And of the sons of Elam; Jeshaiah the son of Athaliah, and with him seventy males.
verses.fr: des fils d''Elam, Esaïe, fils d''Athalia, et avec lui soixante-dix mâles;
verses.am: ከኤላም ልጆች የጎቶልያ ልጅ የሻያ፥ ከእርሱም ጋር ሰባ ወንዶች።

verses.en: And of the sons of Shephatiah; Zebadiah the son of Michael, and with him fourscore males.
verses.fr: des fils de Schephathia, Zebadia, fils de Micaël, et avec lui quatre-vingts mâles;
verses.am: የሰፋጥያስ ልጆች የሚካኤል ልጅ ዝባድያ፥ ከእርሱም ጋር ሰማንያ ወንዶች።

verses.en: Of the sons of Joab; Obadiah the son of Jehiel, and with him two hundred and eighteen males.
verses.fr: des fils de Joab, Abdias, fils de Jehiel, et avec lui deux cent dix-huit mâles;
verses.am: ከኢዮአብ ልጆች የይሒኤል ልጅ አብድዩ፥ ከእርሱም ጋር ሁለት መቶ አሥራ ስምንት ወንዶች።

verses.en: And of the sons of Shelomith; the son of Josiphiah, and with him an hundred and threescore males.
verses.fr: des fils de Schelomith, le fils de Josiphia, et avec lui cent soixante mâles;
verses.am: ከሰሎሚት ልጆች የዮሲፍያ ልጅ፥ ከእርሱም ጋር መቶ ስድሳ ወንዶች።

verses.en: And of the sons of Bebai; Zechariah the son of Bebai, and with him twenty and eight males.
verses.fr: des fils de Bébaï, Zacharie, fils de Bébaï, et avec lui vingt-huit mâles;
verses.am: ከቤባይ ልጆች የቤባይ ልጅ ዘካርያስ፥ ከእርሱም ጋር ሀያ ስምንት ወንዶች።

verses.en: And of the sons of Azgad; Johanan the son of Hakkatan, and with him an hundred and ten males.
verses.fr: des fils d''Azgad, Jochanan, fils d''Hakkathan, et avec lui cent dix mâles;
verses.am: ከዓዝጋድ ልጆች የሃቃጣን ልጅ ዮሐናን፥ ከእርሱም ጋር መቶ አሥር ወንዶች።

verses.en: And of the last sons of Adonikam, whose names are these, Eliphelet, Jeiel, and Shemaiah, and with them threescore males.
verses.fr: des fils d''Adonikam, les derniers, dont voici les noms: Eliphéleth, Jeïel et Schemaeja, et avec eux soixante mâles;
verses.am: ከኋለኞቹ ከአዶኒቃም ልጆች ስማቸው ይህ ነው፤ ኤሊፋላት፥ ይዑኤል፥ ሸማያ፥ ከእነርሱም ጋር ስድሳ ወንዶች።

verses.en: Of the sons also of Bigvai; Uthai, and Zabbud, and with them seventy males.
verses.fr: des fils de Bigvaï, Uthaï et Zabbud, et avec eux soixante-dix mâles.
verses.am: ከበጉዋይ ልጆች ዑታይና ዘቡድ፥ ከእነርሱም ጋር ሰባ ወንዶች።

verses.en: And I gathered them together to the river that runneth to Ahava; and there abode we in tents three days: and I viewed the people, and the priests, and found there none of the sons of Levi.
verses.fr: Je les rassemblai près du fleuve qui coule vers Ahava, et nous campâmes là trois jours. Je dirigeai mon attention sur le peuple et sur les sacrificateurs, et je ne trouvai là aucun des fils de Lévi.
verses.am: ወደ አኅዋም ወደሚፈስስ ወንዝ ሰበሰብኋቸው፥ በዚያም ሦስት ቀን ሰፈርን፤ ሕዝቡንና ካህናቱን ስቈጥራቸው በዚያ ከሌዊ ልጆች ማንንም አላገኘሁም።

verses.en: Then sent I for Eliezer, for Ariel, for Shemaiah, and for Elnathan, and for Jarib, and for Elnathan, and for Nathan, and for Zechariah, and for Meshullam, chief men; also for Joiarib, and for Elnathan, men of understanding.
verses.fr: Alors je fis appeler les chefs Eliézer, Ariel, Schemaeja, Elnathan, Jarib, Elnathan, Nathan, Zacharie et Meschullam, et les docteurs Jojarib et Elnathan.
verses.am: ወደ አለቆቹም ወደ አልዓዛር፥ ወደ አርኤል፥ ወደ ሸማያ፥ ወደ ኤልናታን፥ ወደ ያሪብ፥ ወደ ኤልናታን፥ ወደ ናታን፥ ወደ ዘካርያስ፥ ወደ ሜሱላም፥ ደግሞም ወደ አዋቂዎቹ ወደ ዮያሪብና ወደ ኤልናታን ላክሁ።

verses.en: And I sent them with commandment unto Iddo the chief at the place Casiphia, and I told them what they should say unto Iddo, and to his brethren the Nethinims, at the place Casiphia, that they should bring unto us ministers for the house of our God.
verses.fr: Je les envoyai vers le chef Iddo, demeurant à Casiphia, et je mis dans leur bouche ce qu''ils devaient dire à Iddo et à ses frères les Néthiniens qui étaient à Casiphia, afin qu''ils nous amenassent des serviteurs pour la maison de notre Dieu.
verses.am: በካሲፍያ ስፍራ ወደ ነበረው ወደ አለቃው ወደ አዶ ላክኋቸው፤ ለአምላካችን ቤት አገልጋዮችን ያመጡልን ዘንድ በካሲፍያ ስፍራ ለሚኖሩት ለአዶና ለወንድሞቹ ለናታኒም የሚነግሩአቸውን በአፋቸው አደረግሁ።

verses.en: And by the good hand of our God upon us they brought us a man of understanding, of the sons of Mahli, the son of Levi, the son of Israel; and Sherebiah, with his sons and his brethren, eighteen;
verses.fr: Et, comme la bonne main de notre Dieu était sur nous, ils nous amenèrent Schérébia, homme de sens, d''entre les fils de Machli, fils de Lévi, fils d''Israël, et avec lui ses fils et ses frères, au nombre de dix-huit;
verses.am: በላያችንም መልካም በሆነው በአምላካችን እጅ ከእስራኤል ልጅ ከሌዊ ልጅ ከሞሖሊ ልጆች ወገን የነበረውን አስተዋይ ሰው ሰራብያን፥ ከእርሱም ጋር አሥራ ስምንቱን ልጆቹንና ወንድሞቹን አመጡልን።

verses.en: And Hashabiah, and with him Jeshaiah of the sons of Merari, his brethren and their sons, twenty;
verses.fr: Haschabia, et avec lui Esaïe, d''entre les fils de Merari, ses frères et leurs fils, au nombre de vingt;
verses.am: ደግሞም ሐሸብያን ከእርሱም ጋር ከሜራሪ ልጆች ወገን የነበረውን የሻያንና ሀያውን ወንድሞቹንና ልጆቻቸውን።

verses.en: Also of the Nethinims, whom David and the princes had appointed for the service of the Levites, two hundred and twenty Nethinims: all of them were expressed by name.
verses.fr: et d''entre les Néthiniens, que David et les chefs avaient mis au service des Lévites, deux cent vingt Néthiniens, tous désignés par leurs noms.
verses.am: ሌዋውያንንም እንዲያገለግሉ ዳዊትና አለቆቹ ከሰጡአቸው ናታኒም ውስጥ ሁለት መቶ ሀያ ናታኒም አመጡ፤ እነዚህም ሁሉ በስም በስማቸው ተጠሩ።

verses.en: Then I proclaimed a fast there, at the river of Ahava, that we might afflict ourselves before our God, to seek of him a right way for us, and for our little ones, and for all our substance.
verses.fr: Là, près du fleuve d''Ahava, je publiai un jeûne d''humiliation devant notre Dieu, afin d''implorer de lui un heureux voyage pour nous, pour nos enfants, et pour tout ce qui nous appartenait.
verses.am: በአምላካችን ፊት ራሳችንን እናዋርድ ዘንድ፥ ከእርሱም የቀናውን መንገድ ለእኛና ለልጆቻችን ለንብረታችንም ሁሉ እንለምን ዘንድ በዚያ በአኅዋ ወንዝ አጠገብ ጾም አወጅሁ።

verses.en: For I was ashamed to require of the king a band of soldiers and horsemen to help us against the enemy in the way: because we had spoken unto the king, saying, The hand of our God is upon all them for good that seek him; but his power and his wrath is against all them that forsake him.
verses.fr: J''aurais eu honte de demander au roi une escorte et des cavaliers pour nous protéger contre l''ennemi pendant la route, car nous avions dit au roi: La main de notre Dieu est pour leur bien sur tous ceux qui le cherchent, mais sa force et sa colère sont sur tous ceux qui l''abandonnent.
verses.am: ንጉሡንም። የአምላካችን እጅ በሚሹት ሁሉ ላይ ለመልካም ነው፤ ኃይሉና ቍጣው ግን እርሱን በሚተዉ ሁሉ ላይ ነው ብለን ተናግረን ነበርና በመንገድ ካለው ጠላት ያድኑን ዘንድ ጭፍራና ፈረሰኞች ከንጉሡ እለምን ዘንድ አፍሬ ነበርና።

verses.en: So we fasted and besought our God for this: and he was intreated of us.
verses.fr: C''est à cause de cela que nous jeûnâmes et que nous invoquâmes notre Dieu. Et il nous exauça.
verses.am: ስለዚህም ነገር ጾምን፥ ወደ እግዚአብሔርም ለመንን፤ እርሱም ተለመነን።
